title: Premise
body: Quoderat (from quod erat demonstrandum, "which was to be demonstrated") is a traditional fantasy world of wizards, magic and dragons where power determines status. It is a standalone project, separate from Jorange, set in a world that is not Earth; real history serves only as inspiration. Dungeons have been dropped because they don't fit.

zh.title: 前提
zh.body: 证毕（取自拉丁语 quod erat demonstrandum，意为"证明完毕"）是一个传统奇幻世界，有巫师、魔法与龙，力量决定地位。它是一个独立项目，与 Jorange 无关，设定在一个并非地球的世界里；现实历史仅作灵感。地下城已被删去，因为它们与世界观不符。

title: Law Holders
body:
The top tier are gods who each embody one non-physical natural law, and every such law is unique: one holder at a time, set in stone.

* Mathematical laws count, such as a god of differentiation. Human-defined constants are not laws (for now), so Avogadro's number is out.
* Differentiation and Integration are mathematical inverses, so their gods have a built-in relationship.
* **What holding a law does:**  a holder senses their law operating everywhere and can nudge how it manifests, but cannot rewrite it or stop others from using it. They also sense when someone is trying to disprove it, with the alarm scaling to how serious the attempt is, unless that person is hidden by a physical power that cloaks them completely. The cloak only hides people from law holders, and it belongs to the kitsune family, so any mortal can receive it as a totem.
* Holding a law does not make you stronger in a fight. A physical-power wielder can kill a law holder, and everyone can die. Some holders are ageless, but many things besides old age can kill.
* Scope determines power, and power determines status. There are countless minor gods with very unequal status. Status also has a second axis, impact factor: how much a law has shaped history and daily life. A narrow law with heavy impact can carry more prestige than its power alone suggests.
* Laws can cause physical effects. What holders can't wield is elemental power, which comes from the dragons, while laws are discovered through the Axiom.
* No elemental powers. A holder can only wield them by permanently abandoning their law, which opens its test.
* Day to day, holders study their own law to find its flaws before anyone else does, and lesser holders plot power grabs against bigger ones.
* **Sublaws:**  a law nested under another is separate but weaker. As a private author guideline, two laws are the same only if each overlaps the other by 80% or more, judged by what they govern rather than their form.
* **Disproof:**  a holder claims a specific formulation of a law. Disproof has three outcomes. Partially disproven: the holder survives with a smaller law, and the disprover holds the disproven slice as a new law. Overridden (a broader law exposes a failure in this one): the holder dies, the old law's test opens, and the first disprover holds the new parent law above it (as relativity sits above Newton's gravity). Completely disproven: the test dies too, and the first disprover holds the law that replaces it. These apply even if several people disprove it at once, and the first disprover claims any new law, as with any first discovery. A holder who disproves or revises their own law inherits the result.
* **Demotion:**  discovering a broader law that exposes no failure in an existing one simply makes the existing law its sublaw. The holder lives, demoted. One person can never hold two laws, but a holder can abandon their law to claim a higher one.
* **No disputes over held laws:**  a law that already has a holder can't be discovered, so overlap disputes never arise in-world.
* The Law of All Laws can be disproven, but with no living holder, there is no one to kill. The first disprover gets the new law the disproof forms, which makes them a powerful holder with a stake in the system, not a contender for the Axiom.
* Sublaws under a disproven law die with it only if they are disproven too. If the parent's scope merely shrinks, they survive and can expand into the domain it gave up.

zh.title: 执律者
zh.body:
最顶层是神，每位神化身为一条非物理的自然法则，而每条这样的法则都是唯一的：同一时间只有一位执律者，这一点不可动摇。

* 数学法则也算在内，例如微分之神。人为定义的常数（目前）不算法则，所以阿伏伽德罗常数被排除。
* 微分与积分互为数学上的逆运算，因此它们的神之间天生就有关联。
* **执掌法则意味着什么：** 执律者能感知自己的法则在各处运作，并可以推动它的表现方式，却无法改写它，也无法阻止他人使用它。当有人试图证伪其法则时，他们也能感知到，警报强度与尝试的严重程度相当，除非那人被一种物理之力完全隐匿。这种隐匿只对执律者有效，它属于狐仙一族，因此任何凡人都可能以图腾的形式获得它。
* 执掌法则并不会让你在战斗中更强。驾驭物理之力的人可以杀死执律者，所有人都会死。有些执律者不会衰老，但除了衰老，还有许多东西能致人死地。
* 范围决定力量，力量决定地位。世上有无数地位悬殊的小神。地位还有第二个维度，即影响因子：一条法则在多大程度上塑造了历史与日常生活。一条影响深远的狭窄法则，其声望可能超过其力量本身所显示的。
* 法则可以造成物理效果。执律者无法驾驭的是元素之力，它源自龙族，而法则是通过公理发现的。
* 没有元素之力。执律者只有永久放弃自己的法则才能驾驭元素之力，而放弃会开启该法则的试炼。
* 日常，执律者会钻研自己的法则，赶在别人之前找出其中的漏洞；较弱的执律者则密谋夺取更强者的地位。
* **子法则：** 嵌套在另一条法则之下的法则是独立的，但较弱。作为作者的私下准则，两条法则只有在彼此覆盖80%以上时才算同一条，依据是它们所支配的对象，而非形式。
* **证伪：** 执律者主张的是某条法则的特定表述。证伪有三种结果。部分证伪：执律者存活，但法则缩小，证伪者获得被证伪的那一部分，作为一条新法则。被覆盖（一条更广的法则揭露了这条法则的失效）：执律者死亡，旧法则的试炼开启，第一位证伪者获得凌驾其上的新母法则（正如相对论凌驾于牛顿引力之上）。完全证伪：试炼也随之消亡，第一位证伪者获得取而代之的法则。即使多人同时证伪，这些规则依然适用，而第一位证伪者获得任何新法则，与任何首次发现一样。执律者若证伪或修订自己的法则，则继承其结果。
* **降格：** 发现一条更广的法则，若它未揭露现有法则的任何失效，则只会让现有法则成为它的子法则。执律者存活，但被降格。一个人永远不能同时执掌两条法则，但执律者可以放弃自己的法则，去争取一条更高的法则。
* **已被执掌的法则不会引发争议：** 已有执律者的法则无法被发现，因此世界中不会出现范围重叠的争端。
* 万法之法可以被证伪，但由于没有在世的执律者，也就无人可杀。第一位证伪者获得证伪所形成的新法则，这使其成为一位在体系中拥有利害关系的强大执律者，而非公理的争夺者。
* 被证伪法则之下的子法则，只有在自身也被证伪时才会一同消亡。若母法则只是范围缩小，子法则便能存活，并可扩张至母法则让出的领域。

title: Physical Powers and Dragons
body:
> **Source discrepancy — unresolved:** The Worldbuilding Notes say “for now, none escaped” the hunt; Creatures and Timeline describe surviving families. Both source accounts are preserved here pending an author correction.

Physical (elemental) powers, inspired by Genshin's Visions, are open to everyone; only non-physical laws are unique.

* The division is a metaphysical rule of the world, defined as follows: laws are rules about how things behave, elemental powers are the things themselves, and sublaws sit entirely inside a bigger law. Grey zones like gravity sit in between, are decided case by case, and their category may shift over time.
* **Origin:**  each family of physical power once belonged to one kind of mythical creature. Dragons held the elements, defined as the four states of matter (earth, water, air and plasma); others held families such as life and healing (unicorns), renewal (phoenixes), illusion and concealment (kitsune) and the body itself (trolls), with more to be added as needed. Law holders hunted all of them out of greed (for now, none escaped). The hunters hoped to take the power, but laws and physical powers are mutually exclusive. By the time they realized, the power had been released to every mortal. No mortal is born with physical power. Mortals receive it through totems that the world itself produces and gives to them (the slain creatures' power, soaked into the world and condensed back out), one totem per creature family, and a mortal can wield powers from more than one family.
* **Totems:**  every mortal has a chance to receive one at a certain age, chosen by the world as a fit for them, and more can arrive at random later. The stronger a totem, the rarer it is, so weak totems are common and powerful ones are an elite club. Totems can't be stolen or transferred. When the owner dies, the totem returns to the world.
* Dragons today are not extinct. Surviving creatures keep innate power that doesn't come from totems, which makes them stronger than mortals, but it is exclusive: they can't wield any other family's powers. They cannot grant or revoke powers. They resent the law holders, but they cannot hold laws themselves. They form an organized faction, with details to come.
* Hybrids (half-creatures, half-elves among them) are possible but rare: they are usually sterile, and creatures' hatred of mortals keeps unions scarce. A hybrid is born with innate power, the one exception to totems, and because it can never abandon its own blood, it can never hold a law. Hybrids can also receive totems. On a rough scale of depth, a totem gives 20–30, a full creature's innate power 90–100, and a hybrid's half-blood 40–60, which makes hybrids extremely powerful, rare and discriminated against. Where elves fit is still undecided.

zh.title: 物理之力与龙族
zh.body:
> **来源矛盾，尚未解决：**《世界观笔记》称狩猎中“目前无一逃脱”，但《神兽》与《时间线》记载了幸存族群。此处保留两种记载，等待作者修订。

物理（元素）之力受《原神》中神之眼的启发，向所有人开放；只有非物理的法则才是唯一的。

* **这一划分是世界的形而上规则，定义如下：** 法则是关于事物如何运作的规则，元素之力是事物本身，而子法则完全位于更大的法则之内。引力之类的灰色地带介于两者之间，需逐一判定，其归类也可能随时间改变。
* **起源：** 每一族物理之力都曾属于一种神兽。龙族掌握元素，即物质的四种状态（土、水、气与等离子）；其他神兽掌握各自的力量，例如生命与治愈（独角兽）、重生（不死鸟）、幻术与隐匿（狐仙）以及躯体本身（巨魔），日后可按需增加。执律者出于贪婪猎杀了所有神兽（目前无一逃脱）。猎人们本想夺取力量，但法则与物理之力互不相容。等他们明白过来，力量已经释放给了每一个凡人。没有凡人生来就拥有物理之力。凡人通过世界自身产生并赐予他们的图腾获得力量（即被杀神兽的力量，渗入世界后又被重新凝聚），每一种神兽族群对应一种图腾，一个凡人可以驾驭来自不止一个族群的力量。
* **图腾：** 每个凡人到了一定年龄都有机会获得一个图腾，由世界选择最适合他的那一种，之后还可能随机获得更多。图腾越强越稀有，因此弱图腾很常见，强图腾则属于精英。图腾无法被偷走或转让。持有者死后，图腾回归世界。
* 如今的龙族并未灭绝。幸存的神兽保有不来自图腾的天生力量，这使它们比凡人更强，但这种力量是排他的：它们无法驾驭其他族群的力量。它们无法授予或收回力量。它们怨恨执律者，却无法亲自执掌法则。它们组成了一个有组织的派系，细节待定。
* **混血种（半神兽，半精灵也在其中）有可能出现，但很罕见：** 他们通常无法生育，而神兽对凡人的仇恨也让结合极为稀少。混血种生来便拥有天生力量，这是图腾规则唯一的例外；由于他们永远无法抛弃自己的血统，所以永远无法执掌法则。混血种也可以获得图腾。按粗略的深度刻度，一个图腾为20至30，完整神兽的天生力量为90至100，混血种的半血为40至60，这使混血种极其强大、稀少，并受到歧视。精灵的定位仍未确定。

title: The Test
body:
A law passes to whoever scores highest on its test, and every attempt is punished in proportion to how far the candidate got.

1. Unclaimed laws: discovery is the first test. Claiming is automatic: the discoverer holds the law and sets its test at the same moment.
2. Each holder sets the next test and a secret internal timer when they gain the law. Both stay secret while the holder is alive.
3. The test must be about its law, though a holder can build it around an obscure part of the law.
4. The test opens on vacancy: when the holder dies, permanently abandons the law, or is killed by its disproof. Anyone can attempt it, and the Axiom announces it.
5. Highest score wins, and the winner takes all. The Axiom does the scoring. Scores are hidden, but each candidate can sense their own progress. A candidate who dies has their score invalidated, so leaders must protect themselves. Everyone else's scores stay as they are.
6. Punishment scales with progress, even if the candidate quits partway, ranging from headaches to death. All punishments land at once, when there is a winner.
7. The timer runs only while one candidate leads alone. Any tie at the top, including zero-zero, pauses it. There is no sudden death: a tied law simply waits until someone pulls ahead.
8. No attempts: everyone is tied at zero, so the timer stays paused and the law waits indefinitely.
9. Leaks are allowed: a holder can secretly tell a chosen heir the test, so dynasties are possible.
10. No reclaiming: a holder who abandons a law gives it up permanently.

zh.title: 试炼
zh.body:
法则归属于在其试炼中得分最高的人，而每次尝试都会根据候选者走了多远而受到相应的惩罚。

1. 未被执掌的法则：发现即是第一场试炼。执掌是自动的：发现者在同一时刻执掌法则并设定其试炼。
2. 每位执律者设定下一场试炼，以及一个秘密的内部计时器，在他们获得法则时设定。两者在执律者在世时都保持秘密。
3. 试炼必须与其法则有关，不过执律者可以围绕法则中某个冷僻的部分来设计。
4. 法则空缺时试炼开启：当执律者死亡、永久放弃法则，或因法则被证伪而死时。任何人都可以尝试，公理会公布这一消息。
5. 得分最高者获胜，赢家通吃。公理负责计分。分数是隐藏的，但每位候选者能感知自己的进度。候选者若死亡，其分数作废，因此领先者必须保护好自己。其他人的分数保持不变。
6. 惩罚随进度加重，即使候选者中途退出也一样，轻则头痛，重则死亡。所有惩罚在出现赢家时一并降临。
7. 计时器只在一位候选者单独领先时运行。顶端出现任何平局，包括零比零，都会使其暂停。没有加时赛：平局的法则只会一直等待，直到有人领先。
8. 无人尝试：所有人都以零分持平，计时器保持暂停，法则无限期等待。
9. 允许泄露：执律者可以秘密地把试炼告诉选定的继承人，因此王朝得以存在。
10. 不可收回：放弃法则的执律者永远失去它。

title: The Axiom and the Law of All Laws
body:
The first law holder held the Law of All Laws. He discovered that mortals can wield laws to gain supernatural power and condensed that knowledge into the Axiom, named because, like a mathematical axiom, everyone accepts it without proof: a cheap, mass-produced bracelet anyone can get. He released its instructions openly, so no one can monopolize it.

* Everyone uses it. The Axiom announces when tests open and scores every attempt. People trust its scoring because everyone believes in it.
* The Axiom is his test. To pass, a candidate must break the Axiom open, which everyone believes means hacking in to control it or destroying the server it runs on.
* No one has scored a single point since his death. Every attempt scores zero, so it stays a zero-zero tie and the Law of All Laws remains vacant. A single point would start the timer and put that person in the lead alone.
* Breaking the Axiom is believed to stop everything, which is why people don't go crazy for it. No one actually knows whether that's true, or what the winner would inherit.

zh.title: 公理与万法之法
zh.body:
第一位执律者执掌万法之法。他发现凡人可以驾驭法则以获得超自然之力，并将这一知识凝结为公理。之所以叫公理，是因为它就像数学公理一样，人人都不加证明地接受它：它是一只廉价的、批量生产的手环，任何人都能获得。他公开发布了它的制作方法，因此没有人能垄断它。

* 人人都在使用它。公理会公布试炼何时开启，并为每次尝试打分。人们信任它的计分，因为所有人都相信它。
* 公理就是他的试炼。想要通过，候选者必须破解公理，所有人都认为这意味着入侵并控制它，或摧毁它运行所依赖的服务器。
* 自他死后，没有人得过一分。每次尝试都是零分，所以它始终是零比零的平局，万法之法依然空缺。哪怕只得一分，也会启动计时器，并让那人单独领先。
* 人们相信破解公理会让一切停止，这就是为什么人们不会为之疯狂。实际上，没有人知道这是否属实，也不知道赢家会继承什么。

title: Ordinary People and the Climb
body:
Ordinary people are on the same track as the gods, and the gods cannot stop every climber. Mortal kingdoms and empires rule beneath the gods and creatures.

* The path up is finding a law, so scholars have a natural route to godhood.
* **There is always room at the top:**  mathematics is effectively infinite, so unclaimed laws never run out.
* **Climbing costs something:**  a mortal must give up physical power to hold a law.
* **Built-in tension:**  dynastic heirs who were told the test compete against outsiders who attempt it blind.

zh.title: 普通人与攀登
zh.body:
普通人与神走在同一条路上，而神无法阻止每一个攀登者。凡人的王国与帝国在神与神兽之下进行统治。

* 向上的路是找到一条法则，因此学者天然拥有一条通往神格的道路。
* **顶端永远有空位：** 数学实际上是无穷的，所以未被执掌的法则永远不会用尽。
* **攀登是有代价的：** 凡人必须放弃物理之力才能执掌法则。
* **内在的张力：** 被告知试炼内容的王朝继承人，与盲目尝试的外来者相互竞争。

title: Open Questions
body:
- [ ] Decide privately what the Axiom test's winner inherits. In-world it stays a mystery.
- [ ] If the Law of All Laws is disproven: overridden keeps the Axiom's test open beneath a new parent law; completely disproven kills the test. In-world scholars argue over which would happen.
- [ ] Where is the Axiom's server, given anyone can build a bracelet from the open instructions?

zh.title: 未决问题
zh.body:
* 私下决定公理试炼的赢家会继承什么。在世界中，这始终是个谜。
* **如果万法之法被证伪：** 若是被覆盖，公理的试炼会在一条新母法则之下保持开启；若是完全证伪，试炼就会消亡。世界中的学者为哪种情况会发生而争论不休。
* 既然任何人都能根据公开的方法制作手环，那么公理的服务器在哪里？

title: How the Pantheon Is Ranked
body:
Scope determines power, and power determines status, so the most powerful people in the world are the holders of the broadest laws. The Law of All Laws is vacant, so the top tier begins just below it.

Laws are not limited to STEM. Social laws also count, but STEM laws come first here because they are easier to rank and objectively powerful.

zh.title: 众神如何排位
zh.body:
范围决定力量，力量决定地位，因此世界上最有权势的人，是那些执掌最广法则的人。万法之法空缺，所以顶层从它之下开始。

法则并不限于理工科。社会法则同样算数，但这里先列出理工科法则，因为它们更容易排位，而且客观上更强大。

title: Top-Tier Roster
body:
The top tier splits into three groups by how safe their laws are: logic as the quiet old guard, mathematics as the untouchable aristocracy, and physics as rich but nervous.

| Group | Law | Why it's powerful | Risk of disproof |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Logic | Non-Contradiction | Nothing can be both true and false; every other law depends on it | Nearly impossible |
| Logic | Excluded Middle | Every statement is true or false; just as broad | Contested: intuitionistic logic rejects it |
| Logic | Incompleteness | A law about the limits of laws (Gödel, 1931) | Proven, so very low |
| Mathematics | Number, Sets | The foundations all of mathematics is built on | Proven math can't be disproven |
| Physics | Conservation of Energy | Governs the entire physical world | Can be overridden |
| Physics | Entropy | Governs the entire physical world | Can be overridden |
| Physics | Causality | Governs the entire physical world | Can be overridden |


	Holders for each are still to be defined.

zh.title: 顶层名单
zh.body:
顶层按法则的安全程度分为三组：逻辑是低调的元老，数学是不可撼动的贵族，物理则富有却紧张。

| 组别 | 法则 | 为何强大 | 被证伪的风险 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 逻辑 | 不矛盾律 | 任何事物都不能既真又假；其他每条法则都依赖于它 | 几乎不可能 |
| 逻辑 | 排中律 | 每个命题非真即假；同样宽广 | 存在争议：直觉主义逻辑拒绝它 |
| 逻辑 | 不完备性 | 一条关于法则极限的法则（哥德尔，1931年） | 已被证明，风险极低 |
| 数学 | 数、集合 | 整个数学所依赖的根基 | 已被证明的数学无法被证伪 |
| 物理 | 能量守恒 | 支配整个物理世界 | 可被覆盖 |
| 物理 | 熵 | 支配整个物理世界 | 可被覆盖 |
| 物理 | 因果律 | 支配整个物理世界 | 可被覆盖 |


	


每条法则的执律者仍有待确定。

title: The Law of Non-Contradiction
body:
The first law of the pantheon to be built out. It holds that nothing can be both true and false at the same time and in the same sense.

* **Scope:**  every other law, in mathematics or physics, depends on it, which makes its holder arguably the most powerful living person in the world.
* **Safety:**  it is nearly impossible to disprove, so the holder's main threat is physical rather than intellectual.

### The Holder


Title: The Spear and Shield. The Chinese word for contradiction, 矛盾 (máodùn), comes from the Han Feizi: a merchant claims his spear pierces anything and his shield blocks anything, and a bystander asks what happens when the spear hits the shield. He is the answer to that question.

* **Origin:**  he discovered the law himself and has lived from that ancient time to the present through magic.
* He has a cat. Canon.
* **Longevity:**  he refuses to let himself be both alive and dying, applying his own law to his body.
* **Era:**  laws are discovered through the Axiom, so he came after the first holder built it, which makes him one of the oldest people alive.
* **Nudging:**  around him, uncertainty collapses. Doubt, bluffs and anything undecided are forced to resolve into a single answer.
* **Protection:**  over his long life a dynasty has grown around him, and he hides inside it.
* **Day to day:**  an old man with a cat. No one sees or hears of him 99.99% of the time, but he is always there.

zh.title: 不矛盾律
zh.body:
众神中第一条被完整构建的法则。它主张，任何事物都不能在同一时间、同一意义上既真又假。

* **范围：** 数学与物理中的其他每一条法则都依赖于它，这使它的执律者或许是世上最有权势的在世之人。
* **安全性：** 它几乎不可能被证伪，所以执律者面临的主要威胁是物理上的，而非智识上的。

### 执律者


称号：矛盾。汉语中"矛盾"一词出自《韩非子》：一个商人夸口说他的矛无坚不摧，他的盾无物可破，旁人问他，以子之矛，陷子之盾，何如？他就是这个问题的答案。

* **起源：** 他亲自发现了这条法则，并凭借魔法从那个远古时代一直活到今天。
* 他养了一只猫。这是正史。
* **长寿：** 他拒绝让自己既活着又在死去，把自己的法则施加于自己的身体。
* **时代：** 法则是通过公理发现的，所以他出现在第一位执律者造出公理之后，这使他成为在世最古老的人之一。
* **推动：** 在他身边，不确定性会坍缩。怀疑、虚张声势以及任何悬而未决的事，都会被迫归于唯一的答案。
* **保护：** 在他漫长的一生中，一个王朝在他周围成长起来，而他就藏身其中。
* **日常：** 一个养猫的老人。99.99%的时间里，没有人见过他或听说过他，但他一直都在。

title: The Law of the Excluded Middle
body:
Every statement is either true or false. Together with Non-Contradiction, it makes every statement exactly one of the two. It is as broad as Non-Contradiction but contested, since intuitionistic logic rejects it.

* **Holder:**  Tertia, a young prodigy who inherited the law from her father. Her name comes from the law's Latin motto, tertium non datur, "no third option is given."
* **Lineage:**  a long dynasty. Her father inherited from his great-grandmother, and so on back to a founder who was best friends with S&S (the Spear and Shield). Her ancestors died of many causes, not just old age.
* **Day to day:**  unlike S&S, she is out in the world.
* **Natural threat:**  the holder of Incompleteness. Gödel showed that some truths can never be proven, and to anyone who equates "true" with "provable," that leaves statements that are neither, which is exactly what this law denies.
* **Alliance:**  her family has been allied with S&S since the founding friendship.
* **Nudging:**  near her, the middle disappears. Fence-sitting, neutrality and "it's complicated" stop working, so everyone has to pick a side.

zh.title: 排中律
zh.body:
每个命题要么为真，要么为假。它与不矛盾律一起，使每个命题恰好是两者之一。它与不矛盾律同样宽广，却备受争议，因为直觉主义逻辑拒绝接受它。

* **执律者：** 特尔提娅，一位年轻的天才，从父亲那里继承了这条法则。她的名字来自这条法则的拉丁格言 tertium non datur，意为"没有第三种选择"。
* **血统：** 一个悠久的王朝。她的父亲继承自他的曾祖母，如此一直追溯到一位与矛盾是挚友的创始人。她的祖先死于各种原因，不只是衰老。
* **日常：** 与矛盾不同，她活跃于世间。
* **天敌：** 不完备性的执律者。哥德尔证明，有些真理永远无法被证明；对任何把"真"等同于"可证"的人来说，这就留下了既非真也非假的命题，而这正是这条法则所否认的。
* **同盟：** 自那段奠基的友谊以来，她的家族一直与矛盾结盟。
* **推动：** 在她身边，中间地带会消失。骑墙、中立以及"这很复杂"都不再奏效，每个人都必须选边站。

title: Incompleteness
body:
Any consistent system rich enough to do arithmetic contains truths it can't prove, and can't prove its own consistency (Gödel, 1931).

Title: The Open Question. S&S is where questions go to end; she is proof that some never will.

* **Origin:**  self-made. She discovered the law herself only a few decades ago, a newcomer among ancients with no dynasty.
* **Nudging:**  near her, no system can close. Every rulebook, contract, fortress plan or strategy develops a gap that no revision fully seals; things don't fail, but they are never airtight.
* **Protection:**  no dynasty and no guards. Any plan made against her has a hole in it, so she survives by being impossible to fully plan around.
* **Day to day:**  a flaw-finder for hire. Factions pay her to find loopholes in rivals' treaties and succession claims.
* **Flaw:**  paranoia. Someone who sees the hole in every system eventually trusts none of them, including the people around her.
* **Ambition:**  to partially disprove Excluded Middle and claim the slice she breaks off, perhaps a law of the undecidable. Tertia senses every attempt, so the two are locked in a duel of minds at a distance.
* **Relationships:**  rival to Tertia, philosophical opposite of S&S. He forces answers, Tertia forces sides, and she guarantees there's always one question nobody can settle.

zh.title: 不完备性
zh.body:
任何足以进行算术的一致系统，都包含它无法证明的真理，而且无法证明自身的一致性（哥德尔，1931年）。

称号：未决之问。矛盾是问题终结之处；而她证明了，有些问题永远不会终结。

* **起源：** 白手起家。她在短短几十年前亲自发现了这条法则，是远古众神中的新人，没有王朝。
* **推动：** 在她身边，没有任何系统能够闭合。每一本规则手册、每一份契约、每一个要塞方案或策略，都会出现一个任何修订都无法完全堵上的缺口；事情不会失败，但永远不会滴水不漏。
* **保护：** 没有王朝，也没有守卫。任何针对她的计划都有漏洞，所以她靠着无法被完全算计而生存。
* **日常：** 受雇的找茬者。各个派系付钱请她在对手的条约与继承主张中寻找漏洞。
* **缺陷：** 多疑。一个能看见每个系统漏洞的人，最终谁都不信，包括她身边的人。
* **野心：** 部分证伪排中律，并夺取她分割出来的那一部分，或许是一条不可判定之法。特尔提娅能感知每一次尝试，所以两人隔空陷入一场心智的对决。
* **关系：** 特尔提娅的对手，矛盾在哲学上的对立面。他强迫答案出现，特尔提娅强迫人选边，而她保证总有一个问题无人能够解决。

title: Number and Sets
body:
Number is ancient; Sets was discovered much later, and numbers turned out to be buildable from sets, which put Sets above Number.

### The Feud

1. Sets is discovered. Number becomes its sublaw overnight, demoting its first holder without killing him. The first holder of Sets then killed him by hand, and a new holder took Number.
2. The paradox. A descendant of that first Number holder finds a paradox inside the original Sets (in reality, Russell's paradox of 1901) and uses it to kill the first holder of Sets.
3. The aftermath.
   * Number is now held by the paradox-finder. He went into hiding and has not been found since. Rumor says he went to the dragons.
   * Sets sat empty for a long time until someone inherited it and elevated it with the fix (in reality, the stricter ZFC axioms). Full details to come.

### Sets: Ensa, the Restorer


Her name comes from the French ensemble, "set."

* **Origin:**  Sets sat vacant for generations in a zero-zero tie. Ensa was the first to score and won, then revised her own law with the fix that makes the paradox impossible to state (in reality, Zermelo's 1908 axioms with later additions by Fraenkel and Skolem).
* **Nudging:**  around her, belonging becomes definite: who is in a group, which faction someone serves, where a border falls. Her fixed law forbids a set of everything, so no group near her can claim to contain everything.
* **Signature legend:**  her law includes the Axiom of Choice, whose strangest consequence (the Banach–Tarski paradox) lets a ball be cut and reassembled into two of the same size. Rumor says she once did it with a ball of gold.
* **Weak point:**  the Axiom of Choice can be neither proven nor disproven from the other axioms (Cohen, 1963). That part of her law sits in the Open Question's territory.
* **Consequence for the feud:**  restoring Sets put it back above Number, so the paradox-finder's law is a sublaw again and his revenge was quietly undone.
* **Day to day:**  a builder rather than a fighter, sought out whenever a treaty, guild or kingdom needs a foundation. Close to the logic gods.

### Number: Ilar Hesabu, the Uncounted


His law operates everywhere, yet no one knows where he is. He still uses his family name, Hesabu (Swahili for arithmetic, counting), even under aliases, refusing to let hiding erase his ancestor a second time.

* **Origin:**  raised in the murdered Number holder's diminished dynasty, among genealogies and account books, preparing for Number's test, which his family leaked to him. He is effectively ageless.
* **Nudging:**  he pushes existing quantities toward exact allocations (grain settling into equal portions) while preserving totals. He can't create an extra portion or make a false equation true.
* **Protection:**  he lives under a dragon's protection, revealed to very few. His law gives him information, not defense against a blade or poison.
* **Day to day:**  repairs his host's accounts, teaches arithmetic, and insists every payment is correct, especially wages owed to servants. Patient with honest mistakes, suspicious of anyone who calls a discrepancy "negligible."
* **Flaw:**  he mistook his family's grievance for a right to supremacy. Assuming Sets deserved no successor is the arrogance that made Ensa's restoration possible.
* **Ambition:**  to win back Number's independence. He studies Ensa's foundations for a real failure, while fearing resentment is making him decide the answer in advance.
* **The dragons:**  the rumor is true. Killing the first Sets holder earned him a hearing, not forgiveness, and his host makes him acknowledge the law holders' persecution of dragons as the price of sanctuary.

The paradox. The first holder of Sets was arrogant and sensed Ilar's attempt too late. The paradox exposed a failure, so it counted as an override: one stroke defeated one of the most powerful men of the age, and the next killed him. Sets' test opened, and any new law the paradox formed went unclaimed, since Ilar already held Number. Ever since, every holder has understood the importance of keeping their law clean.

### Relationships

* **S&S:**  respects him as the principle that made the paradox decisive, but avoids him, not wanting his own account of revenge put under the same scrutiny.
* **Tertia:**  admires her speed, distrusts her readiness to turn every distinction into a confrontation.
* **The Open Question:**  unsettled by her foothold in arithmetic, but sees her as an intellectual equal. She can't harm him: Incompleteness guarantees open questions inside arithmetic but never disproves it.
* **Ensa:**  resents her most because she succeeded honestly, repairing the structure whose failure had vindicated him.

zh.title: 数与集合
zh.body:
数是古老的；集合要晚得多才被发现，而数被证明可以由集合构造出来，这使集合凌驾于数之上。

### 宿怨

1. 集合被发现。数一夜之间沦为它的子法则，数的第一位执律者被降格，却未被杀死。随后，集合的第一位执律者亲手杀死了他，一位新的执律者接管了数。
2. 悖论。那位数的第一位执律者的一名后裔，在最初的集合中找到了一个悖论（在现实中，即1901年的罗素悖论），并用它杀死了集合的第一位执律者。
3. 余波。数如今由那位发现悖论的人执掌，他躲了起来，此后再未被找到，传闻他去了龙族那里。集合空置了很长时间，直到有人继承了它，并用修补方案提升了它（在现实中，即更严格的 ZFC 公理），完整细节待定。

### 集合：恩莎，复原者


她的名字来自法语 ensemble，意为"集合"。

* **起源：** 集合在零比零的僵局中空置了数代人。恩莎是第一个得分并获胜的人，随后她用修补方案修订了自己的法则，使悖论无法被表述（在现实中，即策梅洛1908年的公理，以及弗兰克尔与斯科伦后来的补充）。
* **推动：** 在她身边，归属会变得明确：谁属于某个群体，某人效忠于哪个派系，边界落在何处。她修订后的法则禁止"一切的集合"，所以她身边没有任何群体能声称包含一切。
* **标志性传说：** 她的法则包含选择公理，其最奇特的推论（巴拿赫-塔斯基悖论）允许把一个球切开，再重组成两个同样大小的球。传闻她曾用一个金球做到过。
* **弱点：** 选择公理既无法由其他公理证明，也无法被其证伪（科恩，1963年）。她法则的这一部分落在未决之问的领地之内。
* **对宿怨的影响：** 集合的复原使它重新凌驾于数之上，所以那位发现悖论者的法则再次沦为子法则，他的复仇被悄然抹去。
* **日常：** 一位建造者而非战士，每当条约、行会或王国需要奠基时，人们便会找上她。与逻辑之神们关系密切。

### 数：伊拉尔·赫萨布，不计者


他的法则无处不在，却没有人知道他身在何处。即使使用化名，他仍坚持用自己的家族姓氏赫萨布（斯瓦希里语意为"算术、计数"），拒绝让藏匿第二次抹去他的祖先。

* **起源：** 他在那位被害的数之执律者日渐衰落的王朝中长大，身边是族谱与账簿，为数的试炼做准备，而家族向他泄露了试炼的内容。他实际上不会衰老。
* **推动：** 他让现有的数量趋向精确的分配（谷物自行分成相等的份额），同时保持总量不变。他无法凭空多造出一份，也无法让错误的等式成立。
* **保护：** 他生活在龙族的庇护之下，只有极少数人知道。他的法则给予他的是信息，而非抵御刀剑或毒药的防护。
* **日常：** 为东道主整理账目，教人算术，坚持每一笔款项都分毫不差，尤其是欠仆人的工钱。他对诚实的错误很有耐心，却对任何说差额"可以忽略不计"的人心存怀疑。
* **缺陷：** 他把家族的冤屈误当成了称霸的权利。认为集合不配拥有继任者，正是这份傲慢让恩莎的复原成为可能。
* **野心：** 夺回数的独立地位。他研究恩莎的根基，寻找真正的失效，同时又担心怨恨正让他预先设定答案。
* **龙族：** 传闻属实。杀死集合的第一位执律者为他赢得了一次陈情的机会，而非宽恕；他的东道主要求他承认执律者对龙族的迫害，以此作为庇护的代价。

悖论。集合的第一位执律者十分傲慢，察觉伊拉尔的尝试时为时已晚。这个悖论揭露了一处失效，因此算作覆盖：第一击击败了那个时代最有权势的人之一，第二击杀死了他。集合的试炼随之开启，而悖论所形成的任何新法则都无人认领，因为伊拉尔已经执掌了数。从此以后，每位执律者都明白保持自己法则严密无瑕的重要性。

### 关系

* **矛盾：** 伊拉尔敬重他，视其为让悖论具有决定性的那条原则，却回避与他相见，不愿让自己的复仇经历受到同样严格的审视。
* **特尔提娅：** 欣赏她的敏捷，却不信任她动辄把每一个区分都变成对抗的倾向。
* **未决之问：** 她在算术中的立足点让他不安，但他视她为智识上的对手。她伤不了他：不完备性保证算术中存在未决的问题，却从不证伪算术。
* **恩莎：** 他最怨恨她，因为她以正当的方式取得了成功，修复了那个曾以失效证明他正确的结构。

title: The Physics Trio
body:
Broad but overridable: physics holders are rich but nervous.

### Conservation of Energy: Voss Halloran, the Ledger-Keeper


Also called The Closed Book in older texts. Ageless in practice; he has looked sixty-five for well over a century.

* **Origin:**  a miller's son who taught himself mathematics and discovered the law unclaimed, setting its test as he claimed it. He privately suspects he got there by reading rivals' work he shouldn't have seen.
* **Nudging:**  an audit, not a command. He can't create, destroy or stop energy, but he can choose where a discrepancy goes: a fire's waste heat into the ground instead of the granary, as long as the total is unchanged. He can also sense where any loss went.
* **Protection:**  he never fights. Contracts with three elemental mercenary companies, a quiet fortune, and a dozen holders who owe him favors for helping keep their laws clean. He doesn't live where he says he does.
* **Day to day:**  honest ledgers in the morning, then long walks listening to the world add and subtract. A small house full of wound, inaccurate clocks. Dislikes being thanked.
* **Flaw:**  he can't leave an account open, and he trusts tidy formulations over true ones.
* **Ambition:**  to write a formulation so clean, and a test so hard, that his law stays closed for centuries after him. He refuses to name an heir.
* **Exposure:**  high. A broader symmetry law above him would expose no failure, so it would only demote him, and he has quietly begun to prefer that. His favors and contracts would survive a demotion. On cosmic scales, though, his ledger doesn't obviously close, a pressure he can never leave alone. He could abandon his law to claim a higher one. The Law of Symmetry exists but is undiscovered: a vacant slot above every conservation law (energy, momentum, angular momentum). Its discovery would demote them all at once without killing anyone, and it is Voss's one way out, if he dares to abandon his law first.

### Entropy: Rudolf Ludwig, the Chancellor of Thermal Decay

* **Origin:**  inherited through a meticulous dynastic bloodline going back to the law's discoverers.
* **Nudging:**  probability bends under his focus, letting him speed up structural fatigue or briefly delay dispersal in a local system.
* **Protection:**  industrial wealth funding paranoid sentinels who watch for anyone attempting Maxwell's-demon tricks against his law.
* **Day to day:**  auditing engines, stamping out perpetual-motion schemes, and scrubbing his own formulation for the smallest paradox.
* **Flaw:**  crushing anxiety rooted in the death of Sets' first holder, killed by a paradox he sensed too late.
* **Ambition:**  to lock probability into certainty before a broader physics demotes him.
* **Exposure:**  high. He claimed that entropy always increases, the strict formulation, and no one has disproven it yet. He is the god of endings, since entropy is the one process that can't be undone, and he is doomed to end badly: in reality, tiny systems briefly run backward, so the disproof that breaks him is out there waiting to be found.

### Causality: Rushd, the Uncertain Cause

* **Origin:**  discovered. A philosopher-mathematician who formulated the law while wrestling with doubts about whether causation is real or only reliable correlation.
* **Nudging:**  he can't reverse cause and effect, but he can choose which of the permitted effects a cause produces. Nothing he picks can break the speed of light.
* **Protection:**  a small, loyal cadre of scholars and bodyguards, and constant revision of his own formulation to close gaps.
* **Day to day:**  reviewing arguments about causation, mapping causal webs, refining his law's wording. He rarely intervenes in the world.
* **Flaw:**  deep doubt about whether his law describes real necessity or mere correlation, which slows him to call a true counterexample a threat.
* **Ambition:**  to revise causality into a purely logical truth that can't be disproven.
* **Exposure:**  moderate to high. Quantum and relativistic edge cases offer endless apparent counterexamples that threaten but can't kill him; only a broader law of spacetime that exposes a real failure could, and a purely logical account of causation could demote him. Causality counts as a physics law, so it can be overridden.

zh.title: 物理三巨头
zh.body:
宽广却可被覆盖：物理的执律者富有却紧张。

### 能量守恒：沃斯·哈洛兰，记账人


在更古老的典籍中也被称为《合上的账本》。他实际上不会衰老；一百多年来，他看起来一直是六十五岁的样子。

* **起源：** 一个磨坊主的儿子，自学数学，发现了这条无人执掌的法则，并在执掌时设定了它的试炼。他私下怀疑，自己是靠读了本不该看到的对手著作才走到这一步的。
* **推动：** 是审计，而非命令。他无法创造、消灭或阻止能量，但能选择差额流向何处：让火的余热流入地下，而非粮仓，只要总量不变。他还能感知任何损耗去了哪里。
* **保护：** 他从不战斗。他与三家元素佣兵团签有合同，有一笔低调的财富，还有十几位执律者因他帮忙保持法则严密而欠他人情。他并不住在自己所说的地方。
* **日常：** 上午记诚实的账，然后长时间散步，聆听世界的加减。一间小屋子，里面满是上了发条、却都不准的钟。不喜欢被人感谢。
* **缺陷：** 他无法容忍一笔账悬而未决，而且相信整洁的表述胜过真实的表述。
* **野心：** 写出一条极其严密的表述，设下一场极其困难的试炼，让他的法则在他身后几百年都无人能接掌。他拒绝指定继承人。
* **风险：** 高。一条凌驾于他之上的更广的对称性法则不会揭露任何失效，因此只会降格他，而他已悄然开始倾向于这种结局。即使被降格，他的人情与合同也依然有效。然而在宇宙尺度上，他的账本并不明显地平衡，这是一种他永远无法放下的压力。他可以放弃自己的法则，去争取一条更高的法则。对称之法存在，却尚未被发现：那是凌驾于每一条守恒律（能量、动量、角动量）之上的空位。它的发现会一次性降格所有守恒律，却不杀死任何人；而这是沃斯唯一的出路，前提是他敢于先放弃自己的法则。

### 熵：鲁道夫·路德维希，热寂宰相

* **起源：** 通过一条一丝不苟的王朝血脉继承，可追溯到这条法则的发现者。
* **推动：** 概率在他的专注下弯曲，让他能加速结构疲劳，或在一个局部系统中短暂延缓扩散。
* **保护：** 以工业财富供养多疑的哨兵，他们监视任何试图用麦克斯韦妖之类手段对付他法则的人。
* **日常：** 审查引擎，扼杀永动机计划，并反复检查自己的表述，不放过最微小的悖论。
* **缺陷：** 沉重的焦虑，根源在于集合的第一位执律者之死，那人因为察觉悖论太迟而丧命。
* **野心：** 在更广的物理法则降格他之前，把概率锁定为确定。
* **风险：** 高。他主张熵永远增加，这是最严格的表述，至今无人证伪。他是终结之神，因为熵是唯一无法逆转的过程，而他注定不得善终：在现实中，微小的系统会短暂地逆向运行，所以那个将击垮他的证伪，就在某处等待被发现。

### 因果律：鲁什德，不确定之因

* **起源：** 亲自发现。一位哲学家兼数学家，在苦苦思索因果究竟是真实存在、还是仅仅是可靠的相关性时，表述出了这条法则。
* **推动：** 他无法逆转因果，但能在一个原因所允许的结果中选择会产生哪一个。他所选的任何结果都无法打破光速。
* **保护：** 一小群忠诚的学者与护卫，以及对自身表述的不断修订，以堵上漏洞。
* **日常：** 审阅关于因果的论证，绘制因果之网，推敲法则的措辞。他很少干预世事。
* **缺陷：** 他深深怀疑自己的法则描述的究竟是真正的必然，还是仅仅是相关性，这让他迟迟不肯把真正的反例视为威胁。
* **野心：** 把因果律修订为一条无法被证伪的纯逻辑真理。
* **风险：** 中到高。量子与相对论的边缘情况提供了无穷无尽的表面反例，能威胁他却杀不了他；只有一条揭露真正失效的更广的时空法则才能做到，而一个纯逻辑的因果解释则可能降格他。因果律算作物理法则，所以它可以被覆盖。

title: Social Laws
body:
Smaller in scope than physics, since they only operate where people are, but they shape daily life directly. Most are tendencies with known exceptions, so their holders are the most exposed to partial disproof in the world. Where STEM gods are distant forces, social gods sit across the table from you. No rule bars a social law from climbing; in practice, scope keeps them below STEM.

### The Iron Law of Oligarchy: Aldous Vane, the Iron Clerk


Also called Keeper of the Inevitable Few. Every organization, however democratic at the start, ends up run by a small elite.

* **Origin:**  inherited. His predecessor discovered the law watching his own commune centralize within a year, and set Vane's test: join a new trade guild and, without interfering, record the exact moment its assembly gave way to a permanent committee. Vane passed by predicting the committee's members three days early.
* **Nudging:**  "letting the floor tilt." He thickens the friction of flat decision-making: longer agendas, harder-to-reach meeting halls, more technical minutes. Those with time drift to the center; everyone else drifts away.
* **Protection:**  he never leads anything. He attaches to existing hierarchies as a clerk or secretary, and his heirs watch for flat experiments, joining them to disrupt from within or discrediting their records.
* **Day to day:**  a records keeper in a port city's customs house, watching committees form and predicting who gets sidelined first. He keeps a ledger of flat organizations that collapsed into cliques.
* **Flaw:**  bored by stability. He has sabotaged competent councils just to watch a new elite scramble into place, making enemies among holders who value predictability.
* **Ambition:**  to join a truly flat organization that has lasted long enough to threaten him, and be present when the law reasserts itself.
* **Exposure:**  high, through slow accumulation. His formulation says organizations "end up" ruled by a few, so temporary flatness only delays it; what chips at him is an organization that stays flat for its entire life. A large, long-lived one could demote him.

### Supply and Demand: Lian Xiu, the Equilibrium Sovereign

* **Origin:**  inherited after her predecessor's death, with the law already wounded: the Giffen slice (goods whose demand rises with price) had been broken off and is held by someone else.
* **Nudging:**  shifts supply chains and expectations to move market trends, but can't force outcomes.
* **Protection:**  a network of economic analysts watching for anomalies; she avoids impoverished regions where Giffen behavior reappears.
* **Day to day:**  travels between trade hubs, keeping markets balanced and watching for exceptions that could shrink her law.
* **Flaw:**  overconfidence. She ignores early signs of new exceptions, like speculative bubbles or sudden demand surges.
* **Ambition:**  to revise her own formulation so well that the Giffen holder's slice becomes redundant.
* **Exposure:**  high. New market behaviors constantly threaten her, and the Giffen holder is a standing rival probing for weaknesses.

### Goodhart's Law: Mattias Krane, the Moving Target


When a measure becomes a target, it stops being a good measure.

* **Origin:**  discovered. A guild examiner who spent twenty years watching apprentices learn the exam instead of the craft, crystallized by a nail workshop that, paid by count, made thousands of useless tiny nails, and paid by weight, made a few enormous ones.
* **Nudging:**  he senses every measure that has become a target. He can push one further from the truth (a quota's numbers rise while what it counts rots), or shield a measure by keeping people from noticing it judges them.
* **Protection:**  he is unmeasurable. Any metric aimed at finding him (a bounty description, a ranking, a pattern of sightings) stops being reliable the moment it is used to hunt him.
* **Day to day:**  hired by rulers to find which reports are lies, feared by guilds that hit their targets suspiciously well, and paid more by those who want to learn how to game a measure.
* **Flaw:**  he can't want anything openly. The moment he sets a goal, he sees it becoming a target and starts gaming it himself.
* **The Axiom's test:**  he believes no one scores because everyone attempting it is targeting the score. To score a point, you would have to attempt the test without wanting to win, and he is the one person alive who can't stop wanting it.
* **Exposure:**  high, through measures where gaming is improvement: a runner targeting a faster time simply gets faster. Anyone who formalizes that pattern could break off a slice of his law.

zh.title: 社会法则
zh.body:
范围比物理小，因为它们只在有人的地方运作，却直接塑造着日常生活。大多数是存在已知例外的倾向，所以它们的执律者是世界上最容易被部分证伪的人。理工科的神是遥远的力量，而社会之神就坐在你对面的桌旁。没有规则禁止社会法则向上攀升；实际上，是范围让它们居于理工科之下。

### 寡头铁律：奥尔德斯·维恩，铁律书记


也被称为"必然少数的守护者"。每一个组织，无论起初多么民主，最终都会由一小撮精英掌控。

* **起源：** 继承。他的前任在目睹自己的公社一年内走向集权时发现了这条法则，并为维恩设定了试炼：加入一个新的行会，在不加干涉的情况下，记录下它的议会让位于一个常设委员会的确切时刻。维恩提前三天预言了委员会的成员，从而通过了试炼。
* **推动：** "让地板倾斜"。他加重扁平决策的摩擦：更长的议程，更难到达的会场，更专业的会议记录。有时间的人向中心靠拢，其他人则渐渐离开。
* **保护：** 他从不领导任何事物。他以书记或秘书的身份依附于现有的等级结构，而他的继承人则留意各种扁平实验，加入其中从内部破坏，或抹黑它们的记录。
* **日常：** 在一座港口城市的海关担任档案员，观察委员会的形成，预测谁会最先被边缘化。他保留着一本账簿，记录那些沦为小圈子的扁平组织。
* **缺陷：** 厌倦稳定。他曾破坏称职的议会，只为看着新的精英争先恐后地上位，因此与看重可预测性的执律者结下了仇。
* **野心：** 加入一个真正扁平、并且存在得足够久、足以威胁到他的组织，亲眼见证法则重新确立自身的时刻。
* **风险：** 高，来自缓慢的积累。他的表述说组织"最终"会被少数人统治，所以暂时的扁平只是推迟了它；真正蚕食他的，是一个在整个生命周期中都保持扁平的组织。一个庞大而长寿的这类组织可能会降格他。

### 供求律：连秀，均衡女王

* **起源：** 在前任死后继承，而法则当时已经受损：吉芬切片（需求随价格上升的商品）已被分割出去，由另一个人执掌。
* **推动：** 调整供应链与预期，以推动市场趋势，但无法强行决定结果。
* **保护：** 一个监视异常的经济分析师网络；她回避吉芬现象重现的贫困地区。
* **日常：** 往返于各个贸易枢纽之间，维持市场平衡，留意可能缩小她法则的例外。
* **缺陷：** 过度自信。她忽视新例外的早期迹象，比如投机泡沫或需求骤增。
* **野心：** 把自己的表述修订得足够好，让吉芬执律者的那一部分变得多余。
* **风险：** 高。新的市场行为不断威胁着她，而吉芬执律者是一个时刻在试探她弱点的对手。

### 古德哈特定律：马蒂亚斯·克兰，移动靶


当一项指标成为目标，它就不再是一项好的指标。

* **起源：** 亲自发现。一位行会考官，用二十年看着学徒们学会应付考试而非手艺；让他豁然开朗的是一家制钉作坊：按数量计酬时，它造出了成千上万枚毫无用处的小钉子；按重量计酬时，它只造出了几枚巨大的钉子。
* **推动：** 他能感知每一项已经成为目标的指标。他可以把一项指标推得离真相更远（配额的数字不断上升，而它所统计的东西却在腐烂），或者让人们注意不到某项指标正在评判他们，从而保护它。
* **保护：** 他无法被衡量。任何用来寻找他的指标（悬赏描述、排名、目击规律）在被用来追捕他的那一刻就不再可靠。
* **日常：** 受统治者雇用，找出哪些报告是谎言；被那些达标达得可疑的行会所畏惧；而那些想学会如何操纵指标的人，会付给他更多的钱。
* **缺陷：** 他无法公开地想要任何东西。一旦他设定了一个目标，他就会看到它变成靶子，并开始亲自操纵它。
* **公理的试炼：** 他认为没有人得分，是因为每个尝试者都在瞄准分数。想要得一分，你必须在不想赢的状态下尝试，而他恰恰是世上唯一一个无法停止想要的人。
* **风险：** 高，来自那些"操纵即提升"的指标：一个瞄准更快成绩的跑者只会跑得更快。任何把这一规律形式化的人，都可能从他的法则中分割出一部分。

title: Minor Laws
body:
Not the most powerful laws in the world, but the most fun. They are narrow in scope and mostly proven math, so their holders are safe from disproof and free to play.

### The Pigeonhole Principle: Kalyan, the Quiet Heir


Put n+1 things into n boxes, and some box holds two.

* **Name:**  Kalyan, Sanskrit for "auspicious, fortunate": lucky enough to be born into a giant dynasty, not lucky enough to be born into a big branch of it.
* **Origin:**  heir from a small branch of the huge dynasty that grew around S&S. The principle is so simple that it was discovered early, so it has been held within the dynasty ever since. The dynasty is big enough that he has no reason to commit fully to either side, and his branch is small enough that he can't openly take on both.
* **Place:**  a sublaw of Number (Ilar Hesabu), which is itself a sublaw of Sets (Ensa), putting him two levels beneath the Feud.
* **Sensing:**  the law is so intuitive that it works as information. He knows what has collided, never where, just as the real principle is non-constructive: it guarantees a full box exists without saying which one.
* **Nudging:**  he can force two chosen things into the same box (two rivals, two letters, two secrets) without ever learning which box.
* **Role:**  a calm double agent spying for both Ilar and Ensa. He plays exactly two sides.
* **Channel to Ilar:**  he meets a middleman, who passes the note to a dragon, who carries it to Ilar. He never learns where Ilar hides.
* **Exposure:**  very low. Proven math can't be disproven, so his threats are physical.

### The Four Color Theorem: Sai, the Border-Baiter


Any flat map can be colored with four colors so that no two neighboring regions share one. In reality, it was the first major theorem proven by computer (Appel and Haken, 1976).

* **Name:**  Sai, Japanese 彩, "color."
* **Nudging:**  given any four distinct things (paint, banners, stone, crops, uniforms), he can fill any surface so that no two neighbors match.
* **Limits:**  surfaces only, such as floors, walls and land. In three dimensions there is no limit, and on a donut-shaped surface the number rises to seven (Heawood). Every region must also be one connected piece; an empire with exclaves can need more than four.
* **Formulation:**  worded carefully around both limits, so he knows he can't be disproven and is calm about it.
* **Personality:**  a playful prankster, a 乐子人 who stands in the middle and stirs every side (站中间串两边). Where Kalyan plays two sides, Sai plays every possible side at once.
* **The ads:**  on Llama, he was the CEO of the tech company behind a mobile game whose fake ads show players botching map puzzles on purpose. On Origo, he hires actors to carry the puzzles into markets, squares and ports and play dumb until bystanders can't resist fixing them.
* **Motive:**  impact factor, fun and profit. Every person who picks up a puzzle is his law shaping daily life, and the ads pay him on top.
* **Exposure:**  very low.
* **Origin:**  self-made. He came from Llama, where he was the CEO of the tech company behind the game, and he proved the theorem by computer, as Appel and Haken did in reality. He then stepped down, keeping his shares, to hold his law full-time.

### The Halting Problem: Akhil, the Unfinished Answer


No program can decide, for every program, whether it will ever stop (Turing, 1936).

* **Name:**  Akhil, Sanskrit for "whole, complete": a man named "complete" whose law says completion can't be known.
* **Origin:**  self-made, from Llama. A programmer who found the law once Llama had computers, which makes him a recent god like Sai.
* **Nudging:**  around him, no one can tell whether a process (a siege, a negotiation, a progress bar) will ever finish until it does.
* **Personality:**  serene and unhurried. Since nothing can be known to end, he sees no reason to rush anything. He is the calm counterweight to the Open Question's paranoia.
* **Relationship:**  dating the Open Question online, long-distance across the Limitrest Range. Around her no system can close; around him no one can tell whether anything ends. Neither of them knows whether the relationship will.
* **On the Axiom:**  "we will never know when it ends."
* **Flaw:**  he can't end anything. Projects, arguments and goodbyes all stay open, which drives everyone around him mad.
* **Protection:**  he lives on Llama, far from Origo's god politics. The Open Question being close to him is her weak point, not his.
* **Exposure:**  very low. Proven math can't be disproven.

### Mendel's Laws: Zaid, the Patient Gardener


Traits pass from parents to children in predictable ratios.

* **Name:**  Zaid, Arabic for "growth, increase."
* **Origin:**  self-made. He discovered the law through years of slow breeding experiments, and still keeps the garden.
* **Nudging:**  he can verify any bloodline and, within the ratios his law allows, choose which traits a child inherits.
* **Role:**  a kingmaker, working in politics, especially in the kingdoms. His testimony decides which heirs are legitimate, and courtiers who dismiss him as a gardener learn too late that a succession rests on his word.
* **Personality:**  gentle, polite and endlessly patient, with a long memory for every slight.
* **Rival:**  the holder of the linkage slice, who partly disproved him during his own tenure. Zaid survived with a smaller law and considers the slice stolen.
* **Protection:**  every dynasty whose legitimacy rests on his testimony needs him alive and credible. If he is discredited, they fall with him.
* **Exposure:**  high. Real genetics breaks his law in more ways than linkage, so more slices are waiting to be cut.

### The Law of Superposition: Vera, the Witness Beneath


In undisturbed layers, lower layers are older (Steno).

* **Name:**  Vera, Russian for "faith," though many hear the Latin verus, "true": she trusts what the layers show over what anyone says.
* **Origin:**  self-made, a field geologist who found the law in the rock.
* **Formulation:**  worded carefully around "undisturbed," so folds and intrusions can't disprove her.
* **Sensing:**  she reads anything layered (rock, ruins, cities built on cities, history) and senses where layers have been disturbed: tunnels, graves, hidden vaults.
* **Limit:**  the earth tribe's lands are riddled with tunnels, so a single hidden vault there is a needle in a haystack.
* **Day to day:**  hired to find what others buried: smugglers' tunnels, lost tombs, forged ruins, a city's true age.
* **Personality:**  blunt and skeptical. Testimony means nothing to her until the ground agrees.
* **Flaw:**  what leaves no layer escapes her, so she is easily fooled by illusion and by anything that never touched the ground.
* **Ambition:**  to read every layer of Origo, starting with the haystack under the earth tribe. She doesn't know Ilar is down there; she only knows something is.
* **Exposure:**  low.

### To settle

- [ ] Settled: one person can't hold two laws. Killing Sets' holder let Number expand back into its lost status, so the paradox-finder left Sets alone, assuming it was finished, and it sat vacant.
- [ ] Settled: discovering a parent law only kills the holder beneath it if it exposes a failure in their law (as relativity did to Newton). Otherwise the old law is demoted to a sublaw and its holder lives.

zh.title: 小法则
zh.body:
它们并非世上最强大的法则，却是最有趣的。它们范围狭窄，大多是已被证明的数学，所以执律者不必担心被证伪，可以尽情玩耍。

### 抽屉原理：卡利扬，沉默的继承人


把n+1件东西放进n个盒子里，必有一个盒子装着两件。

* **名字：** 卡利扬（Kalyan），梵语意为"吉祥、幸运"：幸运到生在一个庞大的王朝，却没幸运到生在其中的大支。
* **起源：** 围绕矛盾成长起来的那个庞大王朝中，一个小分支的继承人。这条原理简单到很早就被发现，所以此后一直在王朝内部传承。王朝大到让他没有理由完全倒向任何一方，而他的分支又小到让他无法公开同时对抗双方。
* **位置：** 数（伊拉尔·赫萨布）的子法则，而数本身又是集合（恩莎）的子法则，这让他位于宿怨之下两层。
* **感知：** 这条法则直观到可以当作情报来用。他知道什么东西撞在了一起，却永远不知道在哪里，正如真实的抽屉原理是非构造性的：它保证存在一个装满的盒子，却不告诉你是哪一个。
* **推动：** 他能迫使两件选定的东西进入同一个盒子（两个对手、两封信、两个秘密），却永远不知道是哪个盒子。
* **角色：** 一位冷静的双面间谍，同时为伊拉尔和恩莎效力。他只玩两边。
* **与伊拉尔的联络：** 他与一名中间人会面，中间人把信交给一条龙，再由龙带给伊拉尔。他永远不知道伊拉尔藏在哪里。
* **风险：** 极低。已被证明的数学无法被证伪，所以他面临的威胁是物理上的。

### 四色定理：彩，诱边人


任何平面地图都能只用四种颜色着色，且相邻区域颜色不同。在现实中，它是第一个由计算机证明的重大定理（阿佩尔与哈肯，1976年）。

* **名字：** 彩（Sai），日语意为"色彩"。
* **推动：** 给他任意四种不同的东西（颜料、旗帜、石料、作物、制服），他就能填满任何表面，且相邻之处绝不相同。
* **限制：** 只限于表面，例如地面、墙壁与土地。在三维空间中没有上限，而在甜甜圈形的表面上，所需的数目会升到七（希伍德）。每个区域还必须是连成一片的整体；一个拥有飞地的帝国可能需要四种以上的颜色。
* **表述：** 他围绕这两条限制措辞严谨，所以他知道自己无法被证伪，对此十分淡定。
* **性格：** 一个顽皮的恶作剧者，一个站中间串两边的乐子人。卡利扬玩两边，彩则同时玩所有可能的边。
* **广告：** 在羊驼，他曾是一家科技公司的CEO，其手游的虚假广告里，玩家故意把地图谜题搞砸。在原点，他雇演员把谜题带到市场、广场与港口，故意装傻，直到围观者忍不住出手解题。
* **动机：** 影响因子、乐趣与利润。每一个拿起谜题的人，都是他的法则在塑造日常生活，而广告还额外替他赚钱。
* **风险：** 极低。
* **起源：** 白手起家。他来自羊驼，曾是那款手游背后科技公司的CEO，并像现实中的阿佩尔与哈肯一样，用计算机证明了这条定理。此后他卸任CEO，保留股份，成为全职执律者。

### 停机问题：阿基尔，未完的答案


没有任何程序能对所有程序判定它们是否会停止（图灵，1936年）。

* **名字：** 阿基尔（Akhil），梵语意为"完整、圆满"：一个名叫"圆满"的人，他的法则却说圆满无从得知。
* **起源：** 白手起家，来自羊驼。一位程序员，在羊驼有了计算机之后发现了这条法则，这让他像彩一样成为一位新神。
* **推动：** 在他身边，没有人能判断一个过程（一场围城、一次谈判、一条进度条）是否会结束，直到它真的结束。
* **性格：** 从容不迫。既然什么都无法确知会结束，他便觉得没有任何事需要着急。他是未决之问那份多疑的冷静对照。
* **感情：** 与未决之问网恋，隔着极限山脉异地相处。在她身边，没有系统能闭合；在他身边，没人能判断任何事是否会结束。两人都不知道这段感情会不会结束。
* **对公理的看法：** "我们永远不会知道它何时结束。"
* **缺陷：** 他无法结束任何事。项目、争论与告别都悬而未决，让身边每个人都快疯了。
* **保护：** 他住在羊驼，远离原点的众神政治。与他亲近是未决之问的弱点，而不是他的。
* **风险：** 极低。已被证明的数学无法被证伪。

### 孟德尔定律：扎伊德，耐心的园丁


性状以可预测的比例由父母传给子女。

* **名字：** 扎伊德（Zaid），阿拉伯语意为"成长、增加"。
* **起源：** 白手起家。他通过多年缓慢的育种实验发现了这条法则，至今仍打理着那座园子。
* **推动：** 他能验证任何血统，并在法则允许的比例之内，选择一个孩子继承哪些性状。
* **角色：** 一位造王者，活跃于政治，尤其是各个王国。他的证词决定哪些继承人是正统的；那些把他当成园丁而轻视他的廷臣，总是太晚才明白一场继承全系于他的一句话。
* **性格：** 温和、有礼、耐心无穷，却记得每一次怠慢。
* **对手：** 连锁切片的执律者，在他任内部分证伪了他的法则。扎伊德带着缩小的法则活了下来，并认为那一片是被偷走的。
* **保护：** 每一个靠他的证词才获得正统地位的王朝，都需要他活着并且可信。他若被推翻，他们也会随之倒下。
* **风险：** 高。真实的遗传学打破他法则的方式远不止连锁，还有更多切片等着被分割。

### 叠覆律：维拉，地下的见证者


在未受扰动的地层中，下层比上层更古老（斯坦诺）。

* **名字：** 维拉（Vera），俄语意为"信仰"，不过许多人会联想到拉丁语的 verus，即"真实"：她相信地层所显示的，而不是任何人的说法。
* **起源：** 白手起家，一位野外地质学家，在岩石中发现了这条法则。
* **表述：** 她围绕"未受扰动"一词措辞严谨，所以褶皱与侵入体都无法证伪她。
* **感知：** 她能解读任何分层的东西（岩石、废墟、层层叠建的城市、历史），并感知地层在哪里受过扰动：隧道、坟墓、隐秘的地窖。
* **限制：** 土龙族的领地布满隧道，所以那里的一座隐秘地窖，就像大海里的一根针。
* **日常：** 受雇寻找别人埋下的东西：走私隧道、失落的陵墓、伪造的遗迹、一座城市真实的年龄。
* **性格：** 直率而多疑。在地层认同之前，任何证词对她都毫无意义。
* **缺陷：** 不留下地层的东西都能逃过她的眼睛，所以她很容易被幻术，以及任何从未接触地面的东西所欺骗。
* **野心：** 读遍原点的每一层，从土龙族地下那片"大海"开始。她不知道伊拉尔就在下面，只知道下面有东西。
* **风险：** 低。

### 待定事项

* **已定：** 一个人不能同时执掌两条法则。杀死集合的执律者让数重新扩张，夺回了失去的地位，所以那位发现悖论者没有理会集合，以为它已经终结，于是集合陷入空置。
* **已定：** 发现一条母法则，只有在它揭露其下法则的失效时，才会杀死那位执律者（正如相对论对牛顿所做的那样）。否则，旧法则只是降格为子法则，执律者存活。

title: How Creatures Work
body:
> **Source discrepancy — unresolved:** The Worldbuilding Notes say “for now, none escaped” the hunt; Creatures and Timeline describe surviving families. Both source accounts are preserved here pending an author correction.

Each family of physical power once belonged to one kind of mythical creature. Law holders hunted all of them out of greed, hoping to take the power, but laws and physical powers are mutually exclusive, and the power was released into the world instead. The world now hands it out to mortals as totems: the slain creatures' power, soaked into the world and condensed back out.

* Survivors keep innate power. It doesn't come from totems and is far deeper than anything a mortal holds.
* But it is exclusive. A creature can't wield any other family's powers, and can never hold a law.
* **Depth scale (rough):**  a typical totem 20–30 (stronger ones exist but are rarer), a hybrid's half-blood 40–60, a full creature 90–100.
* **The balance:**  creatures go deep (one family, very strong), mortals go wide (several weaker totems), and law holders go up (no physical power, only their law).

zh.title: 神兽如何运作
zh.body:
> **来源矛盾，尚未解决：**《世界观笔记》称狩猎中“目前无一逃脱”，但《神兽》与《时间线》记载了幸存族群。此处保留两种记载，等待作者修订。

每一族物理之力都曾属于一种神兽。执律者出于贪婪猎杀了所有神兽，妄图夺取力量，但法则与物理之力互不相容，力量反而被释放到了世界之中。如今，世界以图腾的形式把力量分发给凡人：那是被杀神兽的力量，渗入世界后又被重新凝聚。

* 幸存者保有天生的力量。它并非来自图腾，远比任何凡人所拥有的更深厚。
* 但它是排他的。神兽无法驾驭其他族群的力量，也永远无法执掌法则。
* **深度刻度（粗略）：** 普通图腾为20至30（更强的图腾存在，但更稀有），混血种的半血为40至60，完整神兽为90至100。
* **平衡：** 神兽走向深（一族力量，极其强大），凡人走向广（多个较弱的图腾），而执律者走向高（没有物理之力，只有自己的法则）。

title: Dragons
body:
The former owners of the elements, each rooted in one state of matter but extending to its substance in any state (ice and steam stay water's, lava stays earth's), giving dragons a monopoly on all matter: earth (solids, from dirt to metals), water (liquids), air (gases, everything in the atmosphere) and plasma (fire and lightning).

* Survived the hunt, but lost their monopoly: the elements are now handed to mortals through totems, and every elemental totem is a fragment of their dead.
* Innate elemental power at full creature depth, but nothing beyond it.
* They resent the law holders and can never hold laws themselves.
* An organized faction.
* Ilar Hesabu (Number) lives under a dragon's protection. His host makes him acknowledge the law holders' persecution of dragons as the price of sanctuary.

### Society

* An entire race, numerous enough for a full society with multiple factions inside it.
* Four tribes by element (earth, water, air, plasma), with ancient rivalries. They have tried to set those aside for a united Dragons, without much success. Ideological factions cut across the tribes, drawing members from all of them.
* Totem users are thieves in dragon eyes, but most dragons accept they can do nothing about it and turn a blind eye. One faction hates this and would kill any totem user on sight, a hatred sharpened by mortals wearing dragon scale and bone, which aren't magical but are exceptional materials.
* **Coexistence:**  much time has passed, and most dragons are looking for a way to live peacefully with the rest of the world.
* **Ilar's hosts:**  the earth tribe shelters him, believing a law holder gives them the upper hand in internal politics and a voice in the world outside.

### The Elder Council


Four elders, one per tribe, sit together as a council of equals who distrust each other; their dead ancestors fought each other. None of them lived through the Great Hunt, which is why the old hatred has faded, and no elder leads the faction that kills totem users on sight. Each tribe names its dragons in its own language.

* Ersetu (earth), Keeper of Deep Vaults: Akkadian, "earth" and "the underworld." Patient and long-memoried, he plays the long game. He pushed the failed unification and secretly shelters Ilar Hesabu; the other three elders don't know.
* **Imaq (water), the Tide-Easer:**  Inuktitut, "water, sea." Adaptable, a mediator who flows around conflict.
* **Salkhi (air), the Horizon-Eye:**  Mongolian, "wind." Distant; sees the whole board and commits to nothing.
* Illapa (plasma), the Unforgiving Spark: Quechua, after the Inca god of thunder and lightning. Volatile and the coldest toward mortals. Refused unification because plasma lands lie closest to mortal settlements and were attacked the most.

zh.title: 龙族
zh.body:
龙族是元素曾经的主人。每种元素植根于一种物质状态，但延伸至其物质的任何状态（冰与蒸汽仍属于水，熔岩仍属于土），这让龙族垄断了一切物质：土（固体，从泥土到金属）、水（液体）、气（气体，大气中的一切）与等离子（火与闪电）。

* **在狩猎中幸存，却失去了垄断：** 元素如今通过图腾交到凡人手中，而每一个元素图腾都是它们死去同族的碎片。
* 天生的元素之力达到完整神兽的深度，但仅此而已。
* 它们怨恨执律者，而且永远无法亲自执掌法则。
* 一个有组织的派系。
* 伊拉尔·赫萨布（数）生活在龙族的庇护之下。他的东道主要求他承认执律者对龙族的迫害，以此作为庇护的代价。

### 社会

* 一个完整的种族，数量多到足以形成一个拥有多个派系的完整社会。
* 按元素分为四个部族（土、水、气、等离子），彼此之间有着古老的竞争。它们曾试图放下这些恩怨，建立一个统一的龙族，却收效甚微。意识形态派系横跨各部族，成员来自每一个部族。
* 在龙族眼中，图腾使用者是窃贼，但大多数龙族接受自己对此无能为力，于是睁一只眼闭一只眼。有一个派系憎恨这一点，见到任何图腾使用者都会将其杀死；凡人身披龙鳞龙骨更加剧了这种仇恨，这些材料并无魔力，却极为非凡。
* **共存：** 时间已经过去很久，大多数龙族都在寻找与世界其他部分和平共处的方式。
* **伊拉尔的东道主：** 土龙族庇护着他，认为一位执律者能让他们在内部政治中占据上风，并在外部世界拥有话语权。

### 长老议会


四位长老，每个部族一位，共同组成一个议会。他们地位平等，却彼此猜忌；他们已故的祖先曾相互厮杀。没有一位长老经历过大狩猎，这就是旧日仇恨得以消退的原因，也没有一位长老领导那个见到图腾使用者就杀的派系。每个部族都用自己的语言为龙命名。

* **埃尔塞图（土），深窖守护者：** 阿卡德语，意为"大地"，也指"冥界"。耐心而记性长久，他下的是一盘大棋。他推动了那场失败的统一，并秘密庇护着伊拉尔·赫萨布；其余三位长老并不知情。
* **伊玛克（水），平潮者：** 因纽特语，意为"水、海"。善于变通，是一位绕开冲突、随势而流的调停者。
* **萨勒希（气），天际之眼：** 蒙古语，意为"风"。疏离超然，纵览全局，却从不表态。
* **伊拉帕（等离子），不赦之焰：** 克丘亚语，取自印加的雷电之神。暴烈无常，对凡人最为冷酷。他拒绝统一，因为等离子部族的领地离凡人聚落最近，遭受的攻击也最多。

title: Other Creature Families
body:
More families can be added as needed. Each draws on real folklore.

### Unicorns: Life and Healing

* **Survivors:**  very few, scattered and solitary. They were hunted hardest, because the hunters wanted their horns as well as their power (medieval Europe believed unicorn horn neutralized poison). The hunters learned too late that a dead unicorn's horn is just bone, since the power returns to the world.
* **Human form:**  unicorns can transform into humans. They look human but are distinctly detectable to anyone who looks closely. Unlike a kitsune's illusion, this is a true bodily change.
* **Among mortals:**  many blend in as medics and humanitarian relief workers, making them the best-liked creatures among ordinary people.
* **Toward totem users:**  their central conflict. They are healers by nature, but every life totem is a piece of their dead. Some refuse to heal anyone carrying one; others heal anyway.
* **Higher-ups:**  opinions are much more mixed, and some remain the most bitter of any family.

### Phoenixes: Renewal

* **Survivors:**  almost all of them. The hunt couldn't fully work on creatures that renew themselves (the self-renewing bird recorded by Herodotus). Each killing released some power into the world, which is where renewal totems come from, and each phoenix came back smaller and without its memories.
* **Society:**  loose and curious, with little sense of history.
* **Toward totem users:**  indifferent or even friendly, the only family with no grudge, because they don't remember being wronged.
* **Coexistence:**  the easiest of any family, which makes them a target: others may want to make them remember.

### Kitsune: Illusion and Concealment

* **Survivors:**  more than anyone thinks. They survived by shapeshifting and hiding among mortals (Japanese fox spirits, masters of disguise), and many still live in disguise.
* **Society:**  a secret network spread through mortal cities.
* **The cloak:**  they hold it at full creature depth and can cloak others as well as themselves.
* **Capitalists:**  witty foxes and quite literally the biggest capitalists in the world. Cloaking is a service, and they sell it.
* **The danger:**  kitsune can't hold laws, but nothing stops a cloaked kitsune scholar from disproving a god undetected. They may be the hidden hand behind unexplained deaths in history.

### Trolls: The Body

* **Survivors:**  a modest number in nocturnal underground clans. The hunters used daylight, since sunlight turns trolls to stone (Scandinavian folklore).
* **Still in stone:**  trolls petrified during the hunt aren't dead. Their power is locked inside rather than released, which is why body totems are rarer than others. Waking them would be a catastrophe or a liberation, depending on who you ask.
* **Society:**  blunt, transactional clans under the mountains, keeping grudges literally carved in stone.
* **Toward totem users:**  settled the troll way, with challenges of strength.

zh.title: 其他神兽族群
zh.body:
日后可按需增加更多族群。每一族都取材于真实的民间传说。

### 独角兽：生命与治愈

* **幸存者：** 极少，分散而孤独。它们遭到最残酷的猎杀，因为猎人既想要它们的力量，也想要它们的角（中世纪欧洲人相信独角兽的角能解毒）。猎人们为时已晚地发现，死去独角兽的角不过是骨头，因为力量已回归世界。
* **人形：** 独角兽可以化为人形。它们看起来像人，但任何仔细观察的人都能清楚地辨认出来。与狐仙的幻术不同，这是真正的肉体变化。
* **在凡人之中：** 许多独角兽以医者和人道救援工作者的身份融入人群，使它们成为普通人最喜爱的神兽。
* **对待图腾使用者：** 这是它们的核心矛盾。它们天性是治愈者，但每一个生命图腾都是它们死去同族的一部分。有些拒绝治疗任何携带生命图腾的人；另一些则照样治疗。
* **高层：** 看法要复杂得多，其中一些仍是所有族群中最为怨恨的。

### 不死鸟：重生

* **幸存者：** 几乎全部幸存。狩猎无法彻底消灭能够自我重生的生物（希罗多德所记载的那只自我重生之鸟）。每一次杀戮都会释放部分力量进入世界，这正是重生图腾的来源；而每一只不死鸟归来时都变得更小，也失去了记忆。
* **社会：** 松散而好奇，几乎没有历史感。
* **对待图腾使用者：** 漠不关心，甚至友好。它们是唯一没有怨恨的族群，因为它们不记得自己曾受到伤害。
* **共存：** 是所有族群中最容易的，这也让它们成为目标：别人可能想让它们想起来。

### 狐仙：幻术与隐匿

* **幸存者：** 比任何人想象的都多。它们靠变化形态、藏身于凡人之中而幸存（日本民间传说中的狐妖，伪装大师），许多至今仍以伪装生活。
* **社会：** 一个遍布凡人城市的秘密网络。
* **隐匿之力：** 它们以完整神兽的深度掌握这种力量，不仅能隐匿自己，也能隐匿他人。
* **资本家：** 机智的狐狸，名副其实是世界上最大的资本家。隐匿是一项服务，而它们出售这项服务。
* **危险：** 狐仙无法执掌法则，但没有什么能阻止一位被隐匿的狐仙学者神不知鬼不觉地证伪一位神。它们或许就是历史上那些不明死亡背后的黑手。

### 巨魔：躯体

* **幸存者：** 数量不多，生活在昼伏夜出的地下氏族中。猎人利用了日光，因为阳光会把巨魔变成石头（斯堪的纳维亚民间传说）。
* **仍在石中：** 在狩猎中被石化的巨魔并没有死。它们的力量被封锁在体内，而非被释放，这就是躯体图腾比其他图腾更稀有的原因。唤醒它们究竟是灾难还是解放，取决于你问的是谁。
* **社会：** 住在山下、直率而讲究交易的氏族，仇恨真的被刻在石头上。
* **对待图腾使用者：** 用巨魔的方式解决，即力量的较量。

title: Hybrids
body:
Half-creatures, half-elves among them. Possible but rare, much as a mortal holding several totem families is possible but rare.

* **Why rare:**  hybrids are usually sterile (as a mule, the offspring of a horse and a donkey, almost always is), and creatures' hatred of mortals keeps unions scarce.
* **Innate power:**  the one exception to totems. A hybrid is born with half-blood depth, 40–60 on the scale.
* **Totems too:**  hybrids can also receive totems, stacking width on top of depth.
* **No laws, ever:**  a hybrid can never abandon its own blood, so it can never hold a law.
* **Standing:**  extremely powerful, rare and discriminated against from every side.
* **Elves:**  where they fit is still undecided.

zh.title: 混血种
zh.body:
半神兽，半精灵也在其中。有可能出现但很罕见，正如一个凡人拥有多个族群的图腾虽有可能但很罕见。

* **为何罕见：** 混血种通常无法生育（就像马与驴的后代骡子几乎总是不育一样），而神兽对凡人的仇恨也让结合极为稀少。
* **天生的力量：** 图腾规则唯一的例外。混血种生来便拥有半血深度，在刻度上为40至60。
* **也能获得图腾：** 混血种同样可以获得图腾，在深度之上再叠加广度。
* **永远不能执掌法则：** 混血种永远无法抛弃自己的血统，因此永远无法执掌法则。
* **地位：** 极其强大，极其罕见，并受到来自各方的歧视。
* **精灵：** 它们的定位仍未确定。

title: Ilar Hesabu
body:
His law operates everywhere, yet no one knows where he is. He still uses his family name, Hesabu (Swahili for arithmetic, counting), even under aliases, refusing to let hiding erase his ancestor a second time.

* **Origin:**  raised in the murdered Number holder's diminished dynasty, among genealogies and account books, preparing for Number's test, which his family leaked to him. He is effectively ageless.
* **Nudging:**  he pushes existing quantities toward exact allocations (grain settling into equal portions) while preserving totals. He can't create an extra portion or make a false equation true.
* **Protection:**  he lives under a dragon's protection, revealed to very few. His law gives him information, not defense against a blade or poison.
* **Day to day:**  repairs his host's accounts, teaches arithmetic, and insists every payment is correct, especially wages owed to servants. Patient with honest mistakes, suspicious of anyone who calls a discrepancy "negligible."
* **Flaw:**  he mistook his family's grievance for a right to supremacy. Assuming Sets deserved no successor is the arrogance that made Ensa's restoration possible.
* **Ambition:**  to win back Number's independence. He studies Ensa's foundations for a real failure, while fearing resentment is making him decide the answer in advance.
* **The dragons:**  the rumor is true. Killing the first Sets holder earned him a hearing, not forgiveness, and his host makes him acknowledge the law holders' persecution of dragons as the price of sanctuary.

The paradox. The first holder of Sets was arrogant and sensed Ilar's attempt too late. The paradox exposed a failure, so it counted as an override: one stroke defeated one of the most powerful men of the age, and the next killed him. Sets' test opened, and any new law the paradox formed went unclaimed, since Ilar already held Number. Ever since, every holder has understood the importance of keeping their law clean.

### Relationships

* **S&S:**  respects him as the principle that made the paradox decisive, but avoids him, not wanting his own account of revenge put under the same scrutiny.
* **Tertia:**  admires her speed, distrusts her readiness to turn every distinction into a confrontation.
* **The Open Question:**  unsettled by her foothold in arithmetic, but sees her as an intellectual equal. She can't harm him: Incompleteness guarantees open questions inside arithmetic but never disproves it.
* **Ensa:**  resents her most because she succeeded honestly, repairing the structure whose failure had vindicated him.

zh.title: 伊拉尔·赫萨布
zh.body:
他的法则无处不在，却没有人知道他身在何处。即使使用化名，他仍坚持用自己的家族姓氏赫萨布（斯瓦希里语意为"算术、计数"），拒绝让藏匿第二次抹去他的祖先。

* **起源：** 他在那位被害的数之执律者日渐衰落的王朝中长大，身边是族谱与账簿，为数的试炼做准备，而家族向他泄露了试炼的内容。他实际上不会衰老。
* **推动：** 他让现有的数量趋向精确的分配（谷物自行分成相等的份额），同时保持总量不变。他无法凭空多造出一份，也无法让错误的等式成立。
* **保护：** 他生活在龙族的庇护之下，只有极少数人知道。他的法则给予他的是信息，而非抵御刀剑或毒药的防护。
* **日常：** 为东道主整理账目，教人算术，坚持每一笔款项都分毫不差，尤其是欠仆人的工钱。他对诚实的错误很有耐心，却对任何说差额"可以忽略不计"的人心存怀疑。
* **缺陷：** 他把家族的冤屈误当成了称霸的权利。认为集合不配拥有继任者，正是这份傲慢让恩莎的复原成为可能。
* **野心：** 夺回数的独立地位。他研究恩莎的根基，寻找真正的失效，同时又担心怨恨正让他预先设定答案。
* **龙族：** 传闻属实。杀死集合的第一位执律者为他赢得了一次陈情的机会，而非宽恕；他的东道主要求他承认执律者对龙族的迫害，以此作为庇护的代价。

悖论。集合的第一位执律者十分傲慢，察觉伊拉尔的尝试时为时已晚。这个悖论揭露了一处失效，因此算作覆盖：第一击击败了那个时代最有权势的人之一，第二击杀死了他。集合的试炼随之开启，而悖论所形成的任何新法则都无人认领，因为伊拉尔已经执掌了数。从此以后，每位执律者都明白保持自己法则严密无瑕的重要性。

### 关系

* **矛盾：** 伊拉尔敬重他，视其为让悖论具有决定性的那条原则，却回避与他相见，不愿让自己的复仇经历受到同样严格的审视。
* **特尔提娅：** 欣赏她的敏捷，却不信任她动辄把每一个区分都变成对抗的倾向。
* **未决之问：** 她在算术中的立足点让他不安，但他视她为智识上的对手。她伤不了他：不完备性保证算术中存在未决的问题，却从不证伪算术。
* **恩莎：** 他最怨恨她，因为她以正当的方式取得了成功，修复了那个曾以失效证明他正确的结构。

title: Ensa
body:
Her name comes from the French ensemble, "set."

* **Origin:**  Sets sat vacant for generations in a zero-zero tie. Ensa was the first to score and won, then revised her own law with the fix that makes the paradox impossible to state (in reality, Zermelo's 1908 axioms with later additions by Fraenkel and Skolem).
* **Nudging:**  around her, belonging becomes definite: who is in a group, which faction someone serves, where a border falls. Her fixed law forbids a set of everything, so no group near her can claim to contain everything.
* **Signature legend:**  her law includes the Axiom of Choice, whose strangest consequence (the Banach–Tarski paradox) lets a ball be cut and reassembled into two of the same size. Rumor says she once did it with a ball of gold.
* **Weak point:**  the Axiom of Choice can be neither proven nor disproven from the other axioms (Cohen, 1963). That part of her law sits in the Open Question's territory.
* **Consequence for the feud:**  restoring Sets put it back above Number, so the paradox-finder's law is a sublaw again and his revenge was quietly undone.
* **Day to day:**  a builder rather than a fighter, sought out whenever a treaty, guild or kingdom needs a foundation. Close to the logic gods.

zh.title: 恩莎
zh.body:
她的名字来自法语 ensemble，意为"集合"。

* **起源：** 集合在零比零的僵局中空置了数代人。恩莎是第一个得分并获胜的人，随后她用修补方案修订了自己的法则，使悖论无法被表述（在现实中，即策梅洛1908年的公理，以及弗兰克尔与斯科伦后来的补充）。
* **推动：** 在她身边，归属会变得明确：谁属于某个群体，某人效忠于哪个派系，边界落在何处。她修订后的法则禁止"一切的集合"，所以她身边没有任何群体能声称包含一切。
* **标志性传说：** 她的法则包含选择公理，其最奇特的推论（巴拿赫-塔斯基悖论）允许把一个球切开，再重组成两个同样大小的球。传闻她曾用一个金球做到过。
* **弱点：** 选择公理既无法由其他公理证明，也无法被其证伪（科恩，1963年）。她法则的这一部分落在未决之问的领地之内。
* **对宿怨的影响：** 集合的复原使它重新凌驾于数之上，所以那位发现悖论者的法则再次沦为子法则，他的复仇被悄然抹去。
* **日常：** 一位建造者而非战士，每当条约、行会或王国需要奠基时，人们便会找上她。与逻辑之神们关系密切。

title: Tertia
body:
Every statement is either true or false. Together with Non-Contradiction, it makes every statement exactly one of the two. It is as broad as Non-Contradiction but contested, since intuitionistic logic rejects it.

* **Holder:**  Tertia, a young prodigy who inherited the law from her father. Her name comes from the law's Latin motto, tertium non datur, "no third option is given."
* **Lineage:**  a long dynasty. Her father inherited from his great-grandmother, and so on back to a founder who was best friends with S&S (the Spear and Shield). Her ancestors died of many causes, not just old age.
* **Day to day:**  unlike S&S, she is out in the world.
* **Natural threat:**  the holder of Incompleteness. Gödel showed that some truths can never be proven, and to anyone who equates "true" with "provable," that leaves statements that are neither, which is exactly what this law denies.
* **Alliance:**  her family has been allied with S&S since the founding friendship.
* **Nudging:**  near her, the middle disappears. Fence-sitting, neutrality and "it's complicated" stop working, so everyone has to pick a side.

zh.title: 特尔提娅
zh.body:
每个命题要么为真，要么为假。它与不矛盾律一起，使每个命题恰好是两者之一。它与不矛盾律同样宽广，却备受争议，因为直觉主义逻辑拒绝接受它。

* **执律者：** 特尔提娅，一位年轻的天才，从父亲那里继承了这条法则。她的名字来自这条法则的拉丁格言 tertium non datur，意为"没有第三种选择"。
* **血统：** 一个悠久的王朝。她的父亲继承自他的曾祖母，如此一直追溯到一位与矛盾是挚友的创始人。她的祖先死于各种原因，不只是衰老。
* **日常：** 与矛盾不同，她活跃于世间。
* **天敌：** 不完备性的执律者。哥德尔证明，有些真理永远无法被证明；对任何把"真"等同于"可证"的人来说，这就留下了既非真也非假的命题，而这正是这条法则所否认的。
* **同盟：** 自那段奠基的友谊以来，她的家族一直与矛盾结盟。
* **推动：** 在她身边，中间地带会消失。骑墙、中立以及"这很复杂"都不再奏效，每个人都必须选边站。

title: The Spear and Shield
body:
The Law of Non-Contradiction

The first law of the pantheon to be built out. It holds that nothing can be both true and false at the same time and in the same sense.

* **Scope:**  every other law, in mathematics or physics, depends on it, which makes its holder arguably the most powerful living person in the world.
* **Safety:**  it is nearly impossible to disprove, so the holder's main threat is physical rather than intellectual.

### The Holder


Title: The Spear and Shield. The Chinese word for contradiction, 矛盾 (máodùn), comes from the Han Feizi: a merchant claims his spear pierces anything and his shield blocks anything, and a bystander asks what happens when the spear hits the shield. He is the answer to that question.

* **Origin:**  he discovered the law himself and has lived from that ancient time to the present through magic.
* He has a cat. Canon.
* **Longevity:**  he refuses to let himself be both alive and dying, applying his own law to his body.
* **Era:**  laws are discovered through the Axiom, so he came after the first holder built it, which makes him one of the oldest people alive.
* **Nudging:**  around him, uncertainty collapses. Doubt, bluffs and anything undecided are forced to resolve into a single answer.
* **Protection:**  over his long life a dynasty has grown around him, and he hides inside it.
* **Day to day:**  an old man with a cat. No one sees or hears of him 99.99% of the time, but he is always there.

zh.title: 矛盾
zh.body:
不矛盾律

众神中第一条被完整构建的法则。它主张，任何事物都不能在同一时间、同一意义上既真又假。

* **范围：** 数学与物理中的其他每一条法则都依赖于它，这使它的执律者或许是世上最有权势的在世之人。
* **安全性：** 它几乎不可能被证伪，所以执律者面临的主要威胁是物理上的，而非智识上的。

### 执律者


称号：矛盾。汉语中"矛盾"一词出自《韩非子》：一个商人夸口说他的矛无坚不摧，他的盾无物可破，旁人问他，以子之矛，陷子之盾，何如？他就是这个问题的答案。

* **起源：** 他亲自发现了这条法则，并凭借魔法从那个远古时代一直活到今天。
* 他养了一只猫。这是正史。
* **长寿：** 他拒绝让自己既活着又在死去，把自己的法则施加于自己的身体。
* **时代：** 法则是通过公理发现的，所以他出现在第一位执律者造出公理之后，这使他成为在世最古老的人之一。
* **推动：** 在他身边，不确定性会坍缩。怀疑、虚张声势以及任何悬而未决的事，都会被迫归于唯一的答案。
* **保护：** 在他漫长的一生中，一个王朝在他周围成长起来，而他就藏身其中。
* **日常：** 一个养猫的老人。99.99%的时间里，没有人见过他或听说过他，但他一直都在。

title: The Open Question
body:
Incompleteness

Any consistent system rich enough to do arithmetic contains truths it can't prove, and can't prove its own consistency (Gödel, 1931).

Title: The Open Question. S&S is where questions go to end; she is proof that some never will.

* **Origin:**  self-made. She discovered the law herself only a few decades ago, a newcomer among ancients with no dynasty.
* **Nudging:**  near her, no system can close. Every rulebook, contract, fortress plan or strategy develops a gap that no revision fully seals; things don't fail, but they are never airtight.
* **Protection:**  no dynasty and no guards. Any plan made against her has a hole in it, so she survives by being impossible to fully plan around.
* **Day to day:**  a flaw-finder for hire. Factions pay her to find loopholes in rivals' treaties and succession claims.
* **Flaw:**  paranoia. Someone who sees the hole in every system eventually trusts none of them, including the people around her.
* **Ambition:**  to partially disprove Excluded Middle and claim the slice she breaks off, perhaps a law of the undecidable. Tertia senses every attempt, so the two are locked in a duel of minds at a distance.
* **Relationships:**  rival to Tertia, philosophical opposite of S&S. He forces answers, Tertia forces sides, and she guarantees there's always one question nobody can settle.

### Relationship — Akhil

From Akhil’s profile:

* **Relationship:**  dating the Open Question online, long-distance across the Limitrest Range. Around her no system can close; around him no one can tell whether anything ends. Neither of them knows whether the relationship will.

[Read Akhil’s profile](#akhil)

zh.title: 未决之问
zh.body:
不完备性

任何足以进行算术的一致系统，都包含它无法证明的真理，而且无法证明自身的一致性（哥德尔，1931年）。

称号：未决之问。矛盾是问题终结之处；而她证明了，有些问题永远不会终结。

* **起源：** 白手起家。她在短短几十年前亲自发现了这条法则，是远古众神中的新人，没有王朝。
* **推动：** 在她身边，没有任何系统能够闭合。每一本规则手册、每一份契约、每一个要塞方案或策略，都会出现一个任何修订都无法完全堵上的缺口；事情不会失败，但永远不会滴水不漏。
* **保护：** 没有王朝，也没有守卫。任何针对她的计划都有漏洞，所以她靠着无法被完全算计而生存。
* **日常：** 受雇的找茬者。各个派系付钱请她在对手的条约与继承主张中寻找漏洞。
* **缺陷：** 多疑。一个能看见每个系统漏洞的人，最终谁都不信，包括她身边的人。
* **野心：** 部分证伪排中律，并夺取她分割出来的那一部分，或许是一条不可判定之法。特尔提娅能感知每一次尝试，所以两人隔空陷入一场心智的对决。
* **关系：** 特尔提娅的对手，矛盾在哲学上的对立面。他强迫答案出现，特尔提娅强迫人选边，而她保证总有一个问题无人能够解决。

### 关系——阿基尔

摘自阿基尔的人物档案：

* **感情：** 与未决之问网恋，隔着极限山脉异地相处。在她身边，没有系统能闭合；在他身边，没人能判断任何事是否会结束。两人都不知道这段感情会不会结束。

[阅读阿基尔的人物档案](#akhil)

title: Voss Halloran
body:
### Conservation of Energy: Voss Halloran, the Ledger-Keeper


Also called The Closed Book in older texts. Ageless in practice; he has looked sixty-five for well over a century.

* **Origin:**  a miller's son who taught himself mathematics and discovered the law unclaimed, setting its test as he claimed it. He privately suspects he got there by reading rivals' work he shouldn't have seen.
* **Nudging:**  an audit, not a command. He can't create, destroy or stop energy, but he can choose where a discrepancy goes: a fire's waste heat into the ground instead of the granary, as long as the total is unchanged. He can also sense where any loss went.
* **Protection:**  he never fights. Contracts with three elemental mercenary companies, a quiet fortune, and a dozen holders who owe him favors for helping keep their laws clean. He doesn't live where he says he does.
* **Day to day:**  honest ledgers in the morning, then long walks listening to the world add and subtract. A small house full of wound, inaccurate clocks. Dislikes being thanked.
* **Flaw:**  he can't leave an account open, and he trusts tidy formulations over true ones.
* **Ambition:**  to write a formulation so clean, and a test so hard, that his law stays closed for centuries after him. He refuses to name an heir.
* **Exposure:**  high. A broader symmetry law above him would expose no failure, so it would only demote him, and he has quietly begun to prefer that. His favors and contracts would survive a demotion. On cosmic scales, though, his ledger doesn't obviously close, a pressure he can never leave alone. He could abandon his law to claim a higher one. The Law of Symmetry exists but is undiscovered: a vacant slot above every conservation law (energy, momentum, angular momentum). Its discovery would demote them all at once without killing anyone, and it is Voss's one way out, if he dares to abandon his law first.

zh.title: 沃斯·哈洛兰
zh.body:
### 能量守恒：沃斯·哈洛兰，记账人


在更古老的典籍中也被称为《合上的账本》。他实际上不会衰老；一百多年来，他看起来一直是六十五岁的样子。

* **起源：** 一个磨坊主的儿子，自学数学，发现了这条无人执掌的法则，并在执掌时设定了它的试炼。他私下怀疑，自己是靠读了本不该看到的对手著作才走到这一步的。
* **推动：** 是审计，而非命令。他无法创造、消灭或阻止能量，但能选择差额流向何处：让火的余热流入地下，而非粮仓，只要总量不变。他还能感知任何损耗去了哪里。
* **保护：** 他从不战斗。他与三家元素佣兵团签有合同，有一笔低调的财富，还有十几位执律者因他帮忙保持法则严密而欠他人情。他并不住在自己所说的地方。
* **日常：** 上午记诚实的账，然后长时间散步，聆听世界的加减。一间小屋子，里面满是上了发条、却都不准的钟。不喜欢被人感谢。
* **缺陷：** 他无法容忍一笔账悬而未决，而且相信整洁的表述胜过真实的表述。
* **野心：** 写出一条极其严密的表述，设下一场极其困难的试炼，让他的法则在他身后几百年都无人能接掌。他拒绝指定继承人。
* **风险：** 高。一条凌驾于他之上的更广的对称性法则不会揭露任何失效，因此只会降格他，而他已悄然开始倾向于这种结局。即使被降格，他的人情与合同也依然有效。然而在宇宙尺度上，他的账本并不明显地平衡，这是一种他永远无法放下的压力。他可以放弃自己的法则，去争取一条更高的法则。对称之法存在，却尚未被发现：那是凌驾于每一条守恒律（能量、动量、角动量）之上的空位。它的发现会一次性降格所有守恒律，却不杀死任何人；而这是沃斯唯一的出路，前提是他敢于先放弃自己的法则。

title: Rudolf Ludwig
body:
### Entropy: Rudolf Ludwig, the Chancellor of Thermal Decay

* **Origin:**  inherited through a meticulous dynastic bloodline going back to the law's discoverers.
* **Nudging:**  probability bends under his focus, letting him speed up structural fatigue or briefly delay dispersal in a local system.
* **Protection:**  industrial wealth funding paranoid sentinels who watch for anyone attempting Maxwell's-demon tricks against his law.
* **Day to day:**  auditing engines, stamping out perpetual-motion schemes, and scrubbing his own formulation for the smallest paradox.
* **Flaw:**  crushing anxiety rooted in the death of Sets' first holder, killed by a paradox he sensed too late.
* **Ambition:**  to lock probability into certainty before a broader physics demotes him.
* **Exposure:**  high. He claimed that entropy always increases, the strict formulation, and no one has disproven it yet. He is the god of endings, since entropy is the one process that can't be undone, and he is doomed to end badly: in reality, tiny systems briefly run backward, so the disproof that breaks him is out there waiting to be found.

zh.title: 鲁道夫·路德维希
zh.body:
### 熵：鲁道夫·路德维希，热寂宰相

* **起源：** 通过一条一丝不苟的王朝血脉继承，可追溯到这条法则的发现者。
* **推动：** 概率在他的专注下弯曲，让他能加速结构疲劳，或在一个局部系统中短暂延缓扩散。
* **保护：** 以工业财富供养多疑的哨兵，他们监视任何试图用麦克斯韦妖之类手段对付他法则的人。
* **日常：** 审查引擎，扼杀永动机计划，并反复检查自己的表述，不放过最微小的悖论。
* **缺陷：** 沉重的焦虑，根源在于集合的第一位执律者之死，那人因为察觉悖论太迟而丧命。
* **野心：** 在更广的物理法则降格他之前，把概率锁定为确定。
* **风险：** 高。他主张熵永远增加，这是最严格的表述，至今无人证伪。他是终结之神，因为熵是唯一无法逆转的过程，而他注定不得善终：在现实中，微小的系统会短暂地逆向运行，所以那个将击垮他的证伪，就在某处等待被发现。

title: Rushd
body:
### Causality: Rushd, the Uncertain Cause

* **Origin:**  discovered. A philosopher-mathematician who formulated the law while wrestling with doubts about whether causation is real or only reliable correlation.
* **Nudging:**  he can't reverse cause and effect, but he can choose which of the permitted effects a cause produces. Nothing he picks can break the speed of light.
* **Protection:**  a small, loyal cadre of scholars and bodyguards, and constant revision of his own formulation to close gaps.
* **Day to day:**  reviewing arguments about causation, mapping causal webs, refining his law's wording. He rarely intervenes in the world.
* **Flaw:**  deep doubt about whether his law describes real necessity or mere correlation, which slows him to call a true counterexample a threat.
* **Ambition:**  to revise causality into a purely logical truth that can't be disproven.
* **Exposure:**  moderate to high. Quantum and relativistic edge cases offer endless apparent counterexamples that threaten but can't kill him; only a broader law of spacetime that exposes a real failure could, and a purely logical account of causation could demote him. Causality counts as a physics law, so it can be overridden.

zh.title: 鲁什德
zh.body:
### 因果律：鲁什德，不确定之因

* **起源：** 亲自发现。一位哲学家兼数学家，在苦苦思索因果究竟是真实存在、还是仅仅是可靠的相关性时，表述出了这条法则。
* **推动：** 他无法逆转因果，但能在一个原因所允许的结果中选择会产生哪一个。他所选的任何结果都无法打破光速。
* **保护：** 一小群忠诚的学者与护卫，以及对自身表述的不断修订，以堵上漏洞。
* **日常：** 审阅关于因果的论证，绘制因果之网，推敲法则的措辞。他很少干预世事。
* **缺陷：** 他深深怀疑自己的法则描述的究竟是真正的必然，还是仅仅是相关性，这让他迟迟不肯把真正的反例视为威胁。
* **野心：** 把因果律修订为一条无法被证伪的纯逻辑真理。
* **风险：** 中到高。量子与相对论的边缘情况提供了无穷无尽的表面反例，能威胁他却杀不了他；只有一条揭露真正失效的更广的时空法则才能做到，而一个纯逻辑的因果解释则可能降格他。因果律算作物理法则，所以它可以被覆盖。

title: Aldous Vane
body:
### The Iron Law of Oligarchy: Aldous Vane, the Iron Clerk


Also called Keeper of the Inevitable Few. Every organization, however democratic at the start, ends up run by a small elite.

* **Origin:**  inherited. His predecessor discovered the law watching his own commune centralize within a year, and set Vane's test: join a new trade guild and, without interfering, record the exact moment its assembly gave way to a permanent committee. Vane passed by predicting the committee's members three days early.
* **Nudging:**  "letting the floor tilt." He thickens the friction of flat decision-making: longer agendas, harder-to-reach meeting halls, more technical minutes. Those with time drift to the center; everyone else drifts away.
* **Protection:**  he never leads anything. He attaches to existing hierarchies as a clerk or secretary, and his heirs watch for flat experiments, joining them to disrupt from within or discrediting their records.
* **Day to day:**  a records keeper in a port city's customs house, watching committees form and predicting who gets sidelined first. He keeps a ledger of flat organizations that collapsed into cliques.
* **Flaw:**  bored by stability. He has sabotaged competent councils just to watch a new elite scramble into place, making enemies among holders who value predictability.
* **Ambition:**  to join a truly flat organization that has lasted long enough to threaten him, and be present when the law reasserts itself.
